utv.uk.title: Long Lost Family - Monday 16 Feb
utv.uk.description: This episode follows a mother searching for the son that she gave up as a teenager and a sister looking for the younger brother her mother was forced to give up before she died of cancer. In our first case, Paula Beer was 17 years old when she had her son and was so terrified of her strict parents' reaction that she didn't tell them. It was only when she went to visit her aunt in Essex that the truth was revealed - Paula loved her son but had to make the heartbreaking decision to give him up for adoption and still tearfully remembers the day she told him 'to remember my voice, I will always love you'. In our second case, Sharon Thomas only learned that she had a younger brother when she was in her twenties - her parents said they couldn't support another child and her teenage mother Margaret made the devastating decision to give him up for adoption. Margaret died just ten months later from leukaemia, and Sharon is now desperate to find her brother for her and for her late mother. (Documentary, Family) - 2011

The line-up is completed by Princess and Junior Andre - the children of Peter Andre and Katie Price - as the four pairs embark on an epic 7,500km race from the prehistoric jungles of Borneo to the sun-baked southern tip of Australia. The competitors cross three countries and two continents, weaving through five checkpoints, before reaching the finish line in Melbourne.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Carabao Cup Live : Liverpool v Chelsea
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E5 Liverpool v Chelsea (Kick-off 8.00pm). Mark Pougatch presents coverage of the fourth-round match at Anfield, as the teams meet in this competition for the first time since the 2023/24 final. A Virgil van Dijk header in the closing minutes of extra time saw the Reds claim a 1-0 victory on that occasion and go on to lift the trophy for the 10th time in their history, which is still the record number of wins for any club in this competition. With analysis from Glen Johnson and Cesar Azpilicueta, commentary by Sam Matterface and Lucy Ward, and reports from Gabriel Clarke.

itv1anglia.uk.description: S28 E2 Latest figures show the number of private parking tickets being given out has reached a record high, at nearly 17 million a year- that's around 46,000 every day. So, with millions more being paid by drivers, are the current rules fair or are motorists being taken for a ride? Paul Brand investigates.

together.uk.title: Lake District Rescue
together.uk.description: Keswick Mountain Rescue team are called to help a fallen scrambler with head and neck injuries who's been precariously lodged at the edge of a waterfall for hours. And a marathon brings its own challenges as temperatures soar towards 30 degrees. (Documentary, Medical) - 2024

together.uk.title: Case Sensitive - Point of Rescue
together.uk.description: Two-part detective drama based on the novel Point of Rescue by Sophie Hannah. When the bodies of a mother and her young daughter are found in the bathroom of their luxury home, new DS Charlie Zailer and her junior colleague DC Simon Waterhouse investigate. The pair immediately clash, disagreeing over whether the case is a murder-suicide or something even more sinister. (Crime drama) - 2011

together.uk.title: Hussy (1980)
together.uk.description: A cabaret hostess and a mysterious American gradually fall in love until their pasts catch up with them. (Drama) - 1980

together.uk.title: Cruel Passion (1978)
together.uk.description: After leaving a convent, two sisters find themselves with no option but to become prostitutes. Justine wishes to remain innocent and virginal, but instead slips into a life of debauchery, torture and slavery. Meanwhile, her flirtatious and liberated sister Juliette receives nothing but happiness and reward for her wanton behaviour. (Historical drama) - 1978

together.uk.title: Edwardian Farm
together.uk.description: It is March and Ruth Goodman, Alex Langlands and Peter Ginn greet the long-awaited arrival of spring. It is time to bring in the daffodil harvest. During it's heyday in the early 20th century, the Tamar Valley was the largest producer of early daffodils in Britain - the result of the region's mild climate combined with the arrival of a railway, which meant produce could be delivered to towns and cities across Britain within hours of bei. (Documentary, History) - 2010

together.uk.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
together.uk.description: Setting out to bring in new livestock and expand his range of produce, Marcus turns his attention to the smallholding's disused chicken coop. In search of the tastiest chicken, as well as some tips on how to rear them, he heads to Leicestershire.

together.uk.title: Flipping Profit - Skipton
together.uk.description: Caroline Hawley, Tony Wong and furniture designer Nessa Doran O'Reilly head to Skipton to find some bargains they can turn into some flipping profit. The three experts will try to outdo each other by unearthing the best that Skipton has to offer.

amc.us.title: House of Wax
amc.us.description: A gang of college friends, including Wade (Jared Padalecki) and his girlfriend, Carly (Elisha Cuthbert), are en route to a school football game when they wind up with a flat tire in a ghost town. They are forced to seek help in the only place that's open: the local wax museum. Once inside the spooky and seemingly abandoned building, they find the works on display are not quite what they seem -- and the group soon discovers it's being hunted by the insane twin brothers who run the museum. (Horror) - 2005

amc.us.title: Final Destination
amc.us.description: Alex Browning is embarking on a trip to Paris. He experiences a premonition -- he sees the plane explode moments after leaving the ground. Insisting that everyone get off the plane, Alex and seven other people are forced to disembark. All watch as the plane actually explodes in a fireball. He and the other survivors have briefly cheated death, but will not be able to evade their fate for very long. One by one, these fugitives from fate fall victim to the grim reaper. (Horror, Thriller) - 2000

amc.us.title: Final Destination 2
amc.us.description: Kimberly (A.J. Cook) has a premonition of a horrible highway accident killing multiple people -- including her and her friends. She blocks the cars behind her on the ramp from joining traffic -- and as a police trooper (Michael Landes) arrives, the accident actually happens. Now, Death is stalking this group of mistaken survivors -- and one by one they are dying as they were supposed to on the highway. (Horror, Thriller) - 2003

amc.us.title: The Final Destination
amc.us.description: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Ghost Ship
amc.us.description: In a remote region of the Bering Sea, a boat salvage crew discovers the eerie remains of a grand passenger liner thought lost for more than 40 years. But once onboard the eerie, cavernous ship, the crew of the Arctic Warrior discovers that the decaying vessel is anything but deserted. It's home to something more deadly and horrific than anything they've encountered in all their years at sea. (Horror, Thriller) - 2002

amc.us.title: Poltergeist
amc.us.description: Strange and creepy happenings beset an average California family, the Freelings -- Steve (Craig T. Nelson), Diane (JoBeth Williams), teenaged Dana (Dominique Dunne), eight-year-old Robbie (Oliver Robins), and five-year-old Carol Ann (Heather O'Rourke) -- when ghosts commune with them through the television set. Initially friendly and playful, the spirits turn unexpectedly menacing, and, when Carol Ann goes missing, Steve and Diane turn to a parapsychologist and eventually an exorcist for help. (Horror, Thriller) - 1982

amc.us.title: The Exorcist
amc.us.description: One of the most profitable horror movies ever made, this tale of an exorcism is based loosely on actual events. When young Regan (Linda Blair) starts acting odd -- levitating, speaking in tongues -- her worried mother (Ellen Burstyn) seeks medical help, only to hit a dead end. A local priest (Jason Miller), however, thinks the girl may be seized by the devil. The priest makes a request to perform an exorcism, and the church sends in an expert (Max von Sydow) to help with the difficult job. (Horror) - 1973

amc.us.title: Child's Play
amc.us.description: After moving to a new city, young Andy Barclay receives a special present from his mother -- a seemingly innocent Buddi doll that becomes his best friend. When the doll suddenly takes on a life of its own, Andy unites with other neighborhood children to stop the sinister toy from wreaking bloody havoc. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

amc.us.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
amc.us.description: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighborhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man, Freddy Krueger (Jackie Earle Haley), terrorizes them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when one of their number dies violently, the friends realize that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake. (Horror) - 2010

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th
amc.us.description: Against the advice of locals and police, Clay (Jared Padalecki) scours the eerie woods surrounding Crystal Lake for his missing sister. But the rotting cabins of an abandoned summer camp are not the only things he finds. Hockey-masked killer Jason Voorhees lies in wait for a chance to use his razor-sharp machete on Clay and the group of college students who have come to the forest to party. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: Thirteen Ghosts
amc.us.description: A state-of-the-art remake of the classic William Castle horror film about a family that inherits a spectacular old house from an eccentric uncle. There's just one problem: the house seems to have a dangerous agenda all its own. Trapped in their new home by strangely shifting walls, the family encounters powerful and vengeful entities that threaten to annihilate anyone in their path. (Horror, Thriller) - 2001

amc.us.title: Child's Play
amc.us.description: Gunned down by Detective Mike Norris (Chris Sarandon), dying murderer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) uses black magic to put his soul inside a doll named Chucky -- which Karen Barclay (Catherine Hicks) then buys for her young son, Andy (Alex Vincent). When Chucky kills Andy's babysitter, the boy realizes the doll is alive and tries to warn people, but he's institutionalized. Now Karen must convince the detective of the murderous doll's intentions, before Andy becomes Chucky's next victim. (Horror, Fantasy, Thriller) - 1988

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

amc.us.title: Halloween 5: The Revenge of Michael Myers
amc.us.description: After lying in a coma for a year, Michael Myers (Donald L. Shanks) awakens and stalks his way back to his small hometown in Illinois, intent on killing his niece, Jamie (Danielle Harris), who has been confined to a mental institution since Michael's last attempt to slay her. Suspecting a psychic link between Michael and Jamie, psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence) joins forces with Sheriff Ben Meeker (Beau Starr) and attempts to stop Michael's latest rampage. (Holiday, Horror) - 1989

amc.us.title: Halloween II
amc.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
amc.us.description: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: Halloween

amc.us.title: Halloween II
amc.us.description: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1981

babytv.uk.description: Squirrel invites his friends to come play with him in his new tree house.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun playing an imaginative game with paper towels and inventing their own song about a choo-choo train!

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam
babytv.uk.description: Join them as they have fun using pan lids as cymbals, singing, and dancing in their band.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become chefs! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a cookbook! S1 Ep27

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets Mrs. Salmon by the river! Salmon jumped too far and landed outside the water!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail sets out on an adventure to the puddle! Join him as he meets a bird and discovers the taste of puddle water!

babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores grass in a garden! Join him as he meets a grasshopper! Discover how his green colour helps him hide from lizards!

babytv.uk.description: It's Autumn! It's getting chilly and the leaves start to fall! Join Mr. Snail as he meets Robin Red Breast.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail has fun exploring ants! Discover that some ants care for the kids, others guard the food, and some build the nest.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun playing hide and seek with a dragon in a magical castle.

babytv.uk.title: LaLe Ki LoLu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu exlore a colorful castle with a very colorful dragon.

babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry are relaxing on the ship when a toucan starts throwing nuts at them but they know how to turn any situation into something fun.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix is watering the beautiful flowers to bloom. But when Pix is out of the water, Leo comes to the rescue and fills more from the stream.

babytv.uk.description: Mowgli bumps into Shere Khan while wandering alone in the jungle. Shere Khan tries to intimidate him but all his tactics don't seem to work.

babytv.uk.description: Today the postwoman arrives on the island with a gift to deliver. Each friend is certain the gift belongs to them. But who is the real recipient?

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: It's the annual fish jumping contest and everyone wants to know who will jump the most amazing jump and win the star medal!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Spain. The King loves travelling in his royal coach but it is always hot inside!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Italy. Maria, the King's daughter doesn't want to eat! S1 Ep13

babytv.uk.title: Billy BamBam

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Little Baby seal doesn't want to sleep - he wants to play of course! Come play hide and seek with him. Peek a boo!

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Six in One, Half-Dozen in the Other
golfpass.us.description: Together six men and six women comprise two teams for the ultimate prize of $100,000 and a chance to play in a PGA Tour or LPGA tournament. Featuring Golf Channel's Blair O'Neal.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Hell Hath No Fury
golfpass.us.description: One on one, man versus woman, and in the blazing heat of the Dominican Republic, the teams try to keep their composure while competing in the dangerously new challenge Strike Eraser. Featuring Golf Channel's Blair O'Neal.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Kill Two Birds With One Stone
golfpass.us.description: One team loses a competitor after that player must leave for the hospital due to illness. The stakes get higher when the Flop Wall now leads two competitors to the benching challenge. Featuring Golf Channel's Blair O'Neal.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - All Talk and No Action
golfpass.us.description: Both teams try their luck in "Take a Chance" and battle for their professional lives. Players are subject to the "Benching Challenge" where cash and elimination are on the line. Featuring Golf Channel's Blair O'Neal.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - When It Rains, It Pours
golfpass.us.description: The ups and downs of the grueling competition are wearing on the teams as a multitude of events are staged. You can cut the tension with a knife as both teams fall victim to internal fighting that might start to derail the weaker players.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Water Under the Bridge
golfpass.us.description: An overnight rain delay causes more tension when a couple of players must wait another day to compete. Finally, both teams go head-to-head to beat elimination and win cash. Featuring Golf Channel's Blair O'Neal.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - No "I" In Team
golfpass.us.description: The teams compete in an "Around the World" challenge testing their chipping and putting skills. As the drama unfolds, some friends turn to enemies and survival is put to the test as the teams try to make it one step closer to the finale.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Birds of a Feather Flock Together
golfpass.us.description: Two players become the clear-cut MVPs, while the rest of the competitors do their best to make up lost ground. It's every player for themselves as a short game and closest to the pin challenge result in two unlikely winners.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Lightning Never Strikes Twice
golfpass.us.description: The most points in any competition are at stake and a player falls ill creating a make-or-break situation for the teams.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - The $100,000 Question
golfpass.us.description: In the finale, the men's and women's team battle it out for cash, prizes and professional exemptions.

secnetwork.us.title: The Paul Finebaum Show ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: Veteran writer, reporter and radio personality Paul Finebaum built a legion of loyal sports fans as the "Voice of the SEC" during 20 years hosting his Birmingham, Ala.-based radio talk show. When ESPN launched the SEC Network in 2014, it was only natural that Finebaum became its first on-air hire, bringing his radio show -- and those passionate followers -- with him. Now originating from one of the SEC Network studios in Charlotte, N.C., the show is a forum for lively discussion and debate of all things SEC and across the spectrum of college sports, with Finebaum playing the role of both moderator and provocateur. The show airs weekday afternoons throughout the year on SEC Network. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2013-12-02

secnetwork.us.title: SEC Now ᴸᶦᵛᵉ
secnetwork.us.description: The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network -- ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference -- is "SEC Now," broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, Peter Burns or Alyssa Lang, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams. (Sports talk, Interview) - 2014-08-14

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : Remembering Vin Scully
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Paying tribute to broadcaster Vin Scully by highlighting some memorable moments from the later years of his career.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 1
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Edwin Diaz and Kyle Tucker join the team at Camelback Ranch as the Dodgers prepare for the 2026 season. Roki Sasaki reflects on the ups and downs of his rookie season including his postseason success as a reliever.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 2
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Miguel Rojas and Clayton Kershaw are mic'd up as they receive their 2025 World Series championship rings. The Dodgers head back to Toronto where Rojas and Andy Pages relive their biggest World Series moments.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 3
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Relief pitcher Will Klein shows off his love for Magic the Gathering and Mookie Betts gives Backstage an inside look at his latest hobby.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 4
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: An all-access look at outfielder Teoscar Hernandez as he works to get back on the field following a hamstring injury. Plus, a look into Hernandez's life at home as he recalls his son's diagnosis of Autism.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 5
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: From his early coaching days in San Diego to three-time World Series champion manager, Backstage takes an in-depth look at Dave Roberts' coaching career as he gets his 1,000th win as a major league manager.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 6
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Two-time Cy Young Award winner Tarik Skubal is acquired at the trade deadline and makes his Dodger debut. Behind the scenes with Dodgers legend Orel Hershiser as he receives his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : 2026 Season Episode 7
sportsnetladodgers.us.description: Dodgers prospect Josue De Paula is mic'd up as he joins the team in Cincinnati. The Dodgers clinch their 13th NL West division title in the last 14 seasons.

sportsnetladodgers.us.title: Backstage: Dodgers : Best of Shohei Ohtani

9life.au.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
9life.au.description: S4 E5 Paradise in Pawleys Island A couple fell in love with the vibe of Pawleys Island, S.C., and now is on the hunt for a getaway space of their own; they find the perfect spot, but the task of modernizing their new vacation home starts to threaten their budget.

9life.au.title: The Block
9life.au.description: S11 E37 Terraces And Re-Do Rooms Revealed Tonight marks the end of nine hard weeks of renovating and the teams are exhausted but ecstatic to reveal their completed apartments to judges Darren, Shaynna and Neale. There's $10,000 prize money up for grabs and Scotty has a special announcement.

9life.au.title: House Hunters International
9life.au.description: S147 E6 Wedding Can Wait, On Isla Mujeres An engaged Philadelphia couple decide to buy a vacation home before getting married, but picking the house of their dreams becomes an intense negotiation when one half keeps a closer eye on price than the other.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S248 E5 Working Out the Atlanta Traffic An entrepreneur seeks a modern apartment near his downtown Atlanta gym, preferring the lively south side, while his girlfriend favours the pricier northern neighbourhood where she resides, creating a conflict in their living preferences.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S251 E6 Making the Case for Grand in Austin A couple with very different styles looks to buy their first home together in Austin, Texas. She wants a large, grand home in the suburbs with room to grow, but he thinks a smaller midcentury modern home near the city is a better investment.

9life.au.title: Global Energy Revolution
9life.au.description: E1 As the global energy revolution accelerates, Roshan Ramnarain joins Aussie cricket star Alex Carey to explore cricket's role in green transition, visits an inspiring Cambodian orphanage project, and tours cutting-edge tech in China.

9life.au.title: Good Bones
9life.au.description: S7 E1 Framing Fiasco in the Valley Mina and the team take on their first home in the Valley, a neighborhood they've never ventured into before. But with no comps in the area and major framing issues, Mina must pull out all the stops if she wants to see a return on this risky investment.

9life.au.title: What's Wrong With That House
9life.au.description: S1 E5 Rustic Barn Turned Timeless Retreat A Maryland family wants to transform an old barn on their property into a home for one of their daughters. Joe Mazza is on a time crunch to make the space livable while designer Noel Gatts must mediate a dad and daughter.

9life.au.title: Home Town
9life.au.description: S8 E9 Unlimited Dreams A learning centre for underserved kids has outgrown its space. Ben & Erin retrofit a larger house into a warm, welcoming school.

9life.au.title: The Block
9life.au.description: S11 E38 One Apartment Five Couples Scotty meets the Blockheads and introduces their final challenge. There are ten rooms to renovate and the teams must each take on two rooms. The budget will be tight and a treasurer is appointed to oversee how every dollar will be spent.

9life.au.title: Good Bones
9life.au.description: S5 E12 Updated Victorian in Old Southside Mina and Karen are back in Old Southside where they've purchased a hoarder house filled with garbage and hiding fire damage. As demo gets underway, they uncover a slew of other issues as they turn this trash-filled home around.

9life.au.title: Help! I Wrecked My House
9life.au.description: S5 E9 Dos and Don'ts of DIY Electric Jasmine rescues a family home plagued by leaks and unfinished DIYs.

9life.au.title: House Hunters International
9life.au.description: S147 E7 The Quest for Less Stress in Riviera Nayarit A California couple seek a slower pace in Mexico; he's ready to park himself on the beach for a well-deserved break, but his partner wants to garden in his dream jungle home.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S248 E6 Searching for Space in Indiana A family wants out of his dad's house and into their own home in Northern Indiana. He wants something cool and retro, but she's set on a place that reminds her of grandma's house.

9life.au.title: House Hunters
9life.au.description: S251 E7 Young Buyer Overwhelmed in Georgia An 18-year-old searches for the perfect home for her young family in Hinesville, Georgia. With her husband overseas in the military, she's doing it on her own, and she wants an older charmer while he's more interested in a new build.

9life.au.title: Bargain Block
9life.au.description: S2 E7 Vintage Circus and Moroccan While scrambling to fix up the Vintage Circus house, Keith and Evan move down the block to create a Moroccan-inspired home with warm colors and intricate tile details.

9life.au.title: No Demo Reno
9life.au.description: S3 E8 60's Refresh A couple is so perplexed by the layout of their 1960s home that they're ready to move. Jenn, however, wants to convince them to stay with a homestead-style renovation that combines vintage elements and cozy functionality with a modern organic twist.

cinemaxaction.us.title: Patti Cake$
cinemaxaction.us.description: Fed up with life in her New Jersey hometown, Patricia Dombrowski, aka Patti Cake$, hopes to follow in the footsteps of her idol and hit the road to achieve stardom as a rapper. With help from her best friend, a mysterious musician and her loving grandmother, Patti leads the charge against an army of haters, unpaid bills and the broken dreams that are holding her back. (Drama, Hip-Hop & Rap, Movie, Music) - 2017-01-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Extraction
cinemaxaction.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2015-12-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Possession
cinemaxaction.us.description: When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2012-08-31

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Wolfman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-02-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trap
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Crime, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2024-08-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: X-Men: First Class
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2011-06-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: MacGruber
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 2010-05-21

cinemaxaction.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemaxaction.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime, Crime drama, Dark comedy, Drama, Movie) - 2017-09-04

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mass Ave
cinemaxaction.us.description: A racial profiling incident forever changes the relationship between a man and his son. (Crime, Drama, Movie) - 2021-11-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Lord of the Flies
cinemaxaction.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1963

cinemaxaction.us.title: Gimme Shelter
cinemaxaction.us.description: The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco. (Documentary, Movie, Music) - 1970-12-06

cinemaxaction.us.title: For All Mankind
cinemaxaction.us.description: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments. (Documentary, History, Movie) - 1989-11-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Flashpoint
cinemaxaction.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller, Western) - 1984

cinemaxaction.us.title: Hall Pass
cinemaxaction.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy, Movie, Romance) - 2011-02-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué. (Drama, Historical drama, Movie, War) - 1987-06-01

cinemaxaction.us.title: Scanners
cinemaxaction.us.description: Scanners are men and women born with incredible telepathic and telekinetic powers. There are many who exercise the benefits of their special gifts in a safe and judicious manner. However, there is a group of renegade scanners who plan to create a race that will rule the world. (Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction, Thriller) - 1981-01-14

cinemaxaction.us.title: Carrie
cinemaxaction.us.description: In this chilling adaptation of Stephen King's horror novel, withdrawn and sensitive teen Carrie White (Sissy Spacek) faces taunting from classmates at school and abuse from her fanatically pious mother (Piper Laurie) at home. When strange occurrences start happening around Carrie, she begins to suspect that she has supernatural powers. Invited to the prom by the empathetic Tommy Ross (William Katt), Carrie tries to let her guard down, but things eventually take a dark and violent turn. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1976-11-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Camp Hell
cinemaxaction.us.description: Horrific events plague a teen when his parents send him to a Christian camp. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2010-08-13

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shut In
cinemaxaction.us.description: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside. (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2016-11-11

cinemaxaction.us.title: Bring Her Back
cinemaxaction.us.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother. (Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 2025-05-30

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Butterfly
cinemaxaction.us.description: On the outskirts of a mountain town grappling with a series of abductions and murders, Paul, a reclusive writer, struggles to start what he hopes will be a career-saving screenplay. After a tense encounter with a drifter named Jack, Paul offers Jack a place to stay. Soon, the edgy, demanding Jack muscles his way into Paul's work. As a storm cuts off power to the isolated cabin, the two men begin a jagged game that will bring at least one tale to an end. (Drama, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2017-05-26

cinemaxaction.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Lara Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Mystery) - 1992-05-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
cinemaxaction.us.description: Ghost Dog (Forest Whitaker) is a contract killer, a master of his trade who can whirl a gun at warp speed and moves through this world like a phantom -- stealthy and evanescent. In the spirit of the samurai, he has pledged his loyalty to a small time mobster named Louie (John Tormey) who saved his life many years before. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie) - 1999-05-18

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ricochet
cinemaxaction.us.description: After tracking down and arresting Earl Talbot Blake (John Lithgow), a psychotic hit man, rookie Los Angeles police officer Nick Styles (Denzel Washington) is hailed as a hero. Several years later, Styles' life appears perfect: He has married his girlfriend, started a family and risen to the position of assistant district attorney. However, his world is turned upside down when Blake escapes from prison with plans to exact brutal and well-calculated revenge. (Action, Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1991

cinemaxaction.us.title: Masterminds
cinemaxaction.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2016-06-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxaction.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Comedy, Drama) - 2018-02-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S03 E12 Evil Is Going On Eric plots his revenge against Russell; Sookie considers a new life without Bill; Tara discovers some surprising news about Sam; Jason finds a new calling; Lafayette turns to Jesus for help; Hoyt hopes for a future with Jessica.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E01 She's Not There Sookie journeys away from Bon Temps; Eric and Bill try to charm the human public; Tara finds refuge; Sam bonds with his own; Hoyt and Jessica debate; Jesus urges Lafayette to join a coven; Terry attempts to alleviate Arlene's fears.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E02 You Smell Like Dinner Sookie adjusts to changes in Bon Temps; Bill reveals parts of his past; Eric crashes a witches' meeting; Jason finds comfort; Andy struggles with his addiction; Sam learns about Luna's talents; Jessica satisfies her cravings.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E03 If You Love Me, Why Am I Dyin'? Sookie makes a deal with Eric; Bill counsels Jessica; Jason is cast as a savior; Tommy alienates Sam; Marnie tests her new powers; Pam gives Lafayette an ultimatum; Eric spoils a reunion.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E04 I'm Alive and on Fire Alcide helps Sookie look for Eric; Marnie seeks guidance to break a spell; Bill discovers a connection with the Bellefleurs; Jason begs for liberation; Sam infiltrates Luna's inner circle; Tommy returns to his roots.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E05 Me and the Devil Sookie nurtures Eric; Bill gets involved in a crisis; Pam takes the veil; Sam becomes Tommy's accomplice; Arlene and Terry seek religion; Jesus and Lafayette travel to Mexico; Jason recovers.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E06 I Wish I Was the Moon Sookie searches for Jason; Marnie connects with spirits; Arlene and Terry contend with an inferno; Debbie urges Alcide to join a new werewolf community; Tommy trades places with Sam; Lafayette feels the spirit; Eric surrenders to his King's will.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E07 Cold Grey Light of Dawn Bill issues an unpopular order; Eric embraces his amnesia; Luna makes a discovery about Sam; Lafayette expands his consciousness; Andy has a date with Holly; Jessica has doubts about the future of her relationship; Alcide and Debbie join a new pack.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E08 Spellbound? Bill and Marnie prepare to face off; Sookie and Eric pledge their allegiance to the king; Jason is torn between friendship and passion; Lafayette becomes a spirit's pawn; Sam contends with another adversary.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E09 Let's Get Out of Here Sookie envisions a world in which both Bill and Eric can exist; Jesus tries to purge the spirit from Lafayette; Marcus enlists Alcide's help in dealing with Sam; Bill clashes with Nan Flanagan; Marnie plots her next move against the vampires.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E10 Burning Down the House Sookie summons her powers to save Bill; Jason urges Jessica to glamour him; Terry drags Andy to an intervention; Alcide reconsiders his allegiances; Bill leads a brigade of vampires in an attack on Moongoddess Emporium.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E11 Soul of Fire Sookie summons her powers to protect Bill, Eric and Pam; Jesus casts a secret spell; Sam settles a score with Marcus; Alcide confronts Debbie; Andy finds passion in the forest; Lafayette is consumed by the past.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S04 E12 And When I Die Spirits surface in Bon Temps; Sookie gains valuable allies; Lafayette's relationship with Jesus is jeopardized; Terry gets an unexpected visitor at Merlotte's; Sam and Luna envision a storybook ending; Debbie confronts Sookie and Tara.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E01 Turn! Turn! Turn! Sookie and Lafayette clean up a mess; Bill and Eric receive a visit from the Vampire Authority; Alcide's werewolf pack goes after Sam; Jessica enjoys her freedom; Jason is visited by Steve Newlin; Alcide warns Sookie.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E02 Authority Always Wins Bill and Eric meet Salome at the Vampire Authority headquarters; Pam recalls her human life and first encounter with Eric; Sookie gets a home-protection system; Arlene investigates Terry's erratic behavior; Steve Newlin makes Jessica an offer.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E03 Whatever I Am, You Made Me Bill and Eric must barter with the head of the Vampire Authority for their lives; Sookie asks for Pam's help; Andy gets a visit from Gordon and Barbara Pelt; Jason reunites with his former high school teacher.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E04 We'll Meet Again Eric and Bill are afraid for their lives; Sookie opens up to Alcide; Lafayette endangers Sookie; Roman and Salome search for a traitor in the council; Andy and Jason go to a party; Terry has a flashback; Sookie drowns her sorrows.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E05 Let's Boot and Rally Bill and Eric hope Sookie can help them find Russell; Lafayette calls out to Jesus' spirit for help; Patrick and Terry are held hostage; Jason has a disturbing dream; Jessica gives Tara advice; Sam gives Luna some bad news.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E06 Hopeless Sookie has a sense of foreboding; Pam breaks up a fight at Fangtasia; Lafayette visits Ruby Jean; Terry blames a curse for his troubles; Alcide challenges J.D.; Sam offers to help Andy; Roman reveals his plans for Russell.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E07 In the Beginning Sookie considers life without faerie powers; Sam locates shooters; Hoyt finds a new group of friends; Alcide prepares for a fight; Lafayette searches for Jesus' body.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E08 Somebody That I Used to Know The Authority heads in a new direction; Sookie and Jason visit the site of their parents' deaths.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E09 Everybody Wants to Rule the World Eric plots his escape; Sookie gets a clue about her parents' murder; Andy and Jason search for leads; Alcide recalls his pack induction; Arlene is caught in Terry and Patrick's crossfire; Steve gets a new pet.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E10 Gone, Gone, Gone The Authority tries to gain public favor; Nora attempts to convert Eric; Jason finds a mysterious scroll; Pam and Tara must obey a new sheriff; Sam and Luna search for Emma; Russell seeks a higher calling.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E11 Sunset Bill slips into religious fervor; the military delivers an ultimatum to the Authority; Sookie seeks insight from the faerie Elder; Alcide reconnects with his father.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S05 E12 Save Yourself Eric tries to save Bill from losing his humanity; Andy must face the consequences of a pact that he made; Alcide prepares for a showdown; Sam and Luna test their limits.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E01 Who Are You, Really? A group flees the Authority compound in the wake of Bill's reincarnation; Sam, Luna and Emma evade guards; Alcide learns about the packmaster job; Andy parents newborn human-faerie hybrids; Governor Truman Burrell vows open season on vampires.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E02 The Sun Jason and Sookie meet a long-lost relative; Tara is victimized by a new government weapon; Eric attempts to thwart the governor's anti-vampire initiatives; Sookie is drawn to a stranger; Alcide and Martha confront Sam about Emma's future.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E03 You're No Good Eric is irate about Burrell's aggression towards vampires; Bill enlists an innovator to synthesize a new type of blood; Sookie begins to learn why Warlow is after her; Sam receives unexpected help from Nicole; Steve Newlin struggles with his past.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E04 At Last Sookie confronts her attraction to Ben; Eric battles Burrell's anti-vampire initiatives; Andy's daughters keep dangerous company; Sam and Nicole make a connection; Bill tasks Takahashi with synthesizing a new kind of blood.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E05 F... the Pain Away Sookie asks Lafayette to summon her parents; Eric and Tara take drastic measures when Pam finds herself in dangerous territory; Sarah Newlin reconnects with Jason; Jessica seeks atonement.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood
hbodrama.us.description: S06 E06 Don't You Feel Me Bill seeks advice from Lilith about the human-vampire crisis; Eric and others look into Vamp Camp; Sam makes a decision about Emma; Andy names his faerie daughter; Arlene has a solution.

hbodrama.us.title: True Blood

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. ion.us.description: Hondo and the team race to stop a nuclear attack on Los Angeles when radioactive material is stolen from a local lab; Powell delves into Alfaro's past when he displays a talent for boxing. (Crime drama, Action, Drama) - 2024-12-13

ion.us.title: S.W.A.T. - Open Season
ion.us.description: The team must race to uncover a dangerous enemy intent on revenge; Deacon and Tan butt heads over Tan's changes to SWAT academy. (Crime drama, Action) - 2025-01-31

mgmplus.us.description: Born with facial differences that, up until now, have prevented him from going to a mainstream school, Auggie Pullman becomes the most unlikely of heroes when he enters the local fifth grade. As his family, his new classmates, and the larger community all struggle to discover their compassion and acceptance, Auggie's extraordinary journey will unite them and prove you can't blend in when you were born to stand out. (Drama) - 2017

While Homer struggles to make a life for himself on his own, he must make monumental decisions that will change the course of his future and deeply affect the lives of those around him. (Drama, Romance) - 1999

mgmplus.us.title: Regretting You
mgmplus.us.description: When a devastating accident reveals a shocking betrayal, Morgan Grant and her daughter, Clara, explore what's left behind as they confront family secrets, redefine love, and rediscover each other. (Drama, Romance) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: Coach Carter
mgmplus.us.description: In 1999, Ken Carter (Samuel L. Jackson) returns to his old high school in Richmond, California, to get the basketball team into shape. With tough rules and academic discipline, he succeeds in setting the players on a winning streak. But when their grades start to suffer, Carter locks them out of the gym and shuts down their championship season. When he is criticized by the players and their parents, he sticks to his guns, determined that they excel in class as well as on the court. (Drama, Biography) - 2005

mgmplus.us.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
mgmplus.us.description: Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan. (Western) - 1965

mgmplus.us.title: Judgment at Nuremberg
mgmplus.us.description: In 1947, four German judges who served on the bench during the Nazi regime face a military tribunal to answer charges of crimes against humanity. Chief Justice Haywood hears evidence and testimony not only from lead defendant Ernst Janning and his defense attorney Hans Rolfe, but also from the widow of a Nazi general, an idealistic U.S. Army captain and reluctant witness Irene Wallner. (Drama) - 1961

mgmplus.us.title: Dead Again
mgmplus.us.description: When a mute woman suffering from amnesia arrives at the gates of an old orphanage, private investigator Mike Church is asked to find out who she is. With the help of a hypnotist, the woman regains her voice and recalls vivid memories of a couple from the 1940s torn apart by murder. Church begins to develop feelings for the woman, who he calls Grace, and then discovers he has a connection to the tragic couple from the 40s. (Mystery, Thriller, Drama) - 1991

mgmplus.us.title: Explorers
mgmplus.us.description: Young Ben Crandall (Ethan Hawke) spends his free time watching sci-fi films, playing video games and reading comic books. Surprisingly, his affinity for all things fantastical yields a real result -- when he has a vivid dream about technology, his science-loving friend Wolfgang Muller (River Phoenix) manages to create a working spacecraft. Joined by their buddy Darren Woods (Jason Presson), the boys take off into outer space and encounter some very odd extraterrestrial life. (Children, Science fiction, Drama) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: Young Sherlock Holmes
mgmplus.us.description: A teenage Sherlock Holmes (Nicholas Rowe) meets and befriends his future sidekick, the bemused and bespectacled John Watson (Alan Cox). During their first semester of boarding school, a series of deaths occur on campus. Intrigued by the crime, Holmes looks into it and soon comes to suspect a poisonous hallucinogen. And then, in the midst of their investigation, Holmes and Watson stumble on a bizarre cult with a penchant for human sacrifice -- after which they must struggle to escape. (Mystery, Adventure, Action, Drama) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: Once Bitten
mgmplus.us.description: A centuries-old vampire, the countess (Lauren Hutton) has kept her youthful look by drinking the blood of male virgins. Since she finds this prey challenging to come by, she is thrilled when she meets young Mark Kendall (Jim Carrey), who wants to lose his virginity, yet has a reluctant girlfriend, Robin (Karen Kopins). After luring Mark away from a club, the countess drinks his blood, but the hapless guy isn't sure what has happened until he starts exhibiting unusual symptoms. (Comedy) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplus.us.description: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

mgmplus.us.title: Ghost Town
mgmplus.us.description: After a near-death experience during a routine colonoscopy, people-hating dentist Bertram Pincus is shocked to discover that he is suddenly able to talk to the dead. Constantly cornered by unhappy spirits who want him to help resolve their earthly problems, the misanthropic Pincus is driven to distraction. Eventually talked into helping the dearly departed Frank Herlihy, Pincus attempts to talk to Frank's widow, Gwen. (Comedy, Fantasy, Romance, Drama) - 2008

mgmplus.us.title: Ghost
mgmplus.us.description: Sam Wheat (Patrick Swayze) is a banker, Molly Jensen (Demi Moore) is an artist, and the two are madly in love. However, when Sam is murdered by friend and corrupt business partner Carl Bruner (Tony Goldwyn) over a shady business deal, he is left to roam the earth as a powerless spirit. When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons. (Fantasy, Romance, Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1990

mgmplus.us.title: What Lies Beneath
mgmplus.us.description: It had been a year since Dr. Norman Spencer betrayed his beautiful wife Claire. But with Claire oblivious to the truth, Norman's life and marriage seem so perfect that when Claire tells him of hearing mysterious voices and seeing a young woman's image in their home, he dismisses her terror as delusion. Claire moves closer to the truth, and it becomes clear that this apparition will not be dismissed, and has come back for Dr. Spencer and his beautiful wife. (Thriller, Horror, Drama) - 2000

mgmplus.us.title: The Haunting
mgmplus.us.description: This horror tale focuses on visitors to the secluded mansion of Hill House who have been called to the isolated location by Dr. David Marrow (Liam Neeson) as part of a study on insomnia. However, Marrow is really investigating fear, and he plans to scare the subjects, including the introverted Nell (Lili Taylor) and the seductive Theo (Catherine Zeta-Jones). Unfortunately for Marrow and everyone staying at Hill House, the manor is actually haunted by an evil spirit out to torment its guests. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 1999

mgmplus.us.title: She Rides Shotgun
mgmplus.us.description: Marked for death by unrelenting enemies, a newly released ex-con must protect his estranged 11-year-old daughter at all costs. With little resources and no one to trust, they form a bond under fire as they evade a corrupt sheriff and a brutal gang leader who'll stop at nothing to protect his criminal interests. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

mgmplus.us.title: Invasion U.S.A.
mgmplus.us.description: Retired CIA agent Matt Hunter (Chuck Norris) is forced back into the business when a villain from his past re-emerges. Soviet Mikhail Rostov (Richard Lynch), a terrorist whom Matt once caught, wants to exact revenge. After failing to find Matt at his Everglades home, Rostov and his army of Communist guerrillas begin carrying out terrorist acts all over southern Florida. Millions of innocent lives are at risk, and it's up to Matt, the National Guard and the FBI to save them. (Action) - 1985

mgmplus.us.title: The Delta Force
mgmplus.us.description: Five years after Maj. Scott McCoy resigned from the U.S. Delta Force due to bureaucracy issues, he returns with Col. Alexander to take down Lebanese terrorists who have hijacked a Boeing 707. Terrorist leader Abdul Rifi takes the crew and passengers hostage as he reroutes the plane to Beirut. When McCoy and Alexander attempt to save the hostages once the plane lands, they are forced to battle a terrorist group that's larger than expected. (Action, Adventure) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: The Magnificent Seven
mgmplus.us.description: Looking to mine for gold, greedy industrialist Bartholomew Bogue seizes control of the Old West town of Rose Creek. With their lives in jeopardy, Emma Cullen and other desperate residents turn to bounty hunter Sam Chisolm for help. Chisolm recruits an eclectic group of gunslingers to take on Bogue and his ruthless henchmen. With a deadly showdown on the horizon, the seven mercenaries soon find themselves fighting for more than just money once the bullets start to fly. (Western, Action, Adventure) - 2016

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - My Town Indy
mgmplus.us.description: WIBC News Director Fred Heckman gets the story of his career when a hostage-taker, Tony Kiritsis, demands to be interviewed live on air; Fred must decide whether to air the explosive interview. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-09-20

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - McMahon, Martinis & Madness
mgmplus.us.description: Fred has a groundbreaking on-air interview with Tony, only to find himself pulled further and further away from his role as news director. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-09-20

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - Magic Ticket Sweepstakes
mgmplus.us.description: When a report from WIBC sends Tony into a deadly spiral, Fred is forced to embrace the role of hostage negotiator to prolong Dick's life. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-09-27

mgmplus.us.title: American Hostage - A Taste of Indianapolis
mgmplus.us.description: Fred, in trying to talk Tony through a dark period of despondency, ends up revealing deep personal truths that have repercussions for his marriage. (Crime, Thriller) - 2026-10-04

mgmplushits.us.title: Crimson Tide
mgmplushits.us.description: After the Cold War, a breakaway Russian republic with nuclear warheads becomes a possible worldwide threat. U.S. submarine Capt. Frank Ramsey (Gene Hackman) signs on a relatively green but highly recommended Lt. Cmdr. Ron Hunter (Denzel Washington) to the USS Alabama, which may be the only ship able to stop a possible Armageddon. When Ramsay insists that the Alabama must act aggressively, Hunter, fearing they will start rather than stop a disaster, leads a potential mutiny to stop him. (Thriller, Drama) - 1995

mgmplushits.us.title: Training Day
mgmplushits.us.description: Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost? (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2001

mgmplushits.us.title: American Gangster
mgmplushits.us.description: Frank Lucas earns his living as a chauffeur to one of Harlem's leading mobsters. After his boss dies, Frank uses his own ingenuity and strict business code to become one of the inner city's most powerful crime bosses. Veteran cop Richie Roberts senses a change in the mob's power structure and looks for ways to bring his opponent to justice. (Crime drama, Biography) - 2007

mgmplushits.us.title: Out of Time
mgmplushits.us.description: Matt Lee Whitlock (Denzel Washington) is the police chief of a small Florida town, going through a divorce with his detective wife, Alex (Eva Mendes). He begins a passionate affair with Ann (Sanaa Lathan), only to find out that she's stricken with terminal cancer. Matt steals a large sum of money confiscated from a drug bust in order to pay for Ann's treatment -- but when she apparently dies in a suspicious fire, the money disappears, and all the clues point to Matt as the culprit. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Unhuman
mgmplushits.us.description: Seven misfit students must band together against a growing gang of unhuman savages. Their trust in each other gets tested to the limit in a brutal, horrifying fight to survive as they take down the murderous zombie creatures. (Horror, Thriller) - 2022

mgmplushits.us.title: Bloodsport
mgmplushits.us.description: U.S. soldier Frank Dux (Jean-Claude Van Damme) has come to Hong Kong to be accepted into the Kumite, a highly secret and extremely violent martial-arts competition. While trying to gain access into the underground world of clandestine fighters, he also has to avoid military officers who consider him to be AWOL. After enduring a difficult training and beginning a romance with journalist Janice Kent (Leah Ayres), Frank is given the opportunity to fight. But can he survive? (Action, Martial arts) - 1988

mgmplushits.us.title: Disturbing Behavior
mgmplushits.us.description: Steve Clark (James Marsden) is a newcomer in the town of Cradle Bay, and he quickly realizes that there's something odd about his high school classmates. The clique known as the Blue Ribbons are the eerie embodiment of academic excellence and clean living. But, like the rest of the town, they're a little too perfect. When Steve's rebellious friend Gavin (Nick Stahl) mysteriously joins their ranks, Steve searches for the truth with fellow misfit Rachel (Katie Holmes). (Horror, Mystery, Science fiction) - 1998

mgmplushits.us.title: From Beyond
mgmplushits.us.description: Obsessive scientist Dr. Pretorius (Ted Sorel) successfully discovers a way to access a parallel universe of pleasure by tapping into the brain's pineal gland. When he is seemingly killed by forces from this other dimension, his assistant, Dr. Crawford Tillinghast (Jeffrey Combs), is accused of the murder. After psychiatrist Katherine McMichaels (Barbara Crampton) and detective Bubba Brownlee (Ken Foree) take the case, the trio risks a return to the other world in order to solve the mystery. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: Lady Jane
mgmplushits.us.description: King Henry VIII has died, and his only heir, a young Edward VI (Warren Saire), is dying too. Minister John Dudley (John Wood) doesn't want the Roman Catholic Princess Mary (Jane Lapotaire) to become queen, as that would end the Protestant Reformation. Dudley plots to keep Edward alive long enough to name Lady Jane Grey (Helena Bonham Carter) as his heir and also marries Jane to his son, Guilford (Cary Elwes). Jane and Guilford soon fall in love, but the kingdom doesn't believe they should rule. (Historical drama) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power
mgmplushits.us.description: Former Vice President Al Gore continues his tireless fight, traveling around the world to train an army of activists and influence international climate policy. Cameras follow him behind the scenes -- in moments both private and public, funny and poignant -- as he pursues the inspirational idea that while the stakes have never been higher, the perils of climate change can be overcome with human ingenuity and passion. (Documentary) - 2017

mgmplushits.us.title: Chaplin
mgmplushits.us.description: Re-creation of the life of comic genius Charles Chaplin, from his humble beginnings in south London through his early days in British vaudeville, his silent movie career in America and his late masterpieces. His turbulent personal life saw four marriages and an enforced exile from the US - though he returned to receive an honorary Oscar in 1972. (Biography) - 1992

mgmplushits.us.title: Imagine That
mgmplushits.us.description: Like many busy professionals, Evan Danielson (Eddie Murphy) is so focused on his career that quality time with his young daughter, Olivia (Yara Shahidi), has fallen by the wayside. When an important promotion is suddenly within reach, stressed-out Evan starts to fall apart while trying to fend off his company rival (Thomas Haden Church). But when little Olivia introduces him to the inhabitants of her imaginary land, Evan rediscovers his inner child and finds the answers to all his problems. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Drama) - 2009

mgmplushits.us.title: North Dallas Forty
mgmplushits.us.description: A brutal satire of American professional football in which a veteran pass-catcher's individuality and refusal to become part of the team family is bitterly resented by his disciplinarian coaches. The National Football League refused to help in the production of this movie, suggesting it may have been too near the truth for comfort. From the novel by former NFL player Peter Gent. (Comedy drama) - 1979

mgmplushits.us.title: The School of Rock
mgmplushits.us.description: Overly enthusiastic guitarist Dewey Finn (Jack Black) gets thrown out of his bar band and finds himself in desperate need of work. Posing as a substitute music teacher at an elite private elementary school, he exposes his students to the hard rock gods he idolizes and emulates -- much to the consternation of the uptight principal (Joan Cusack). As he gets his privileged and precocious charges in touch with their inner rock 'n' roll animals, he imagines redemption at a local Battle of the Bands. (Comedy, Music) - 2003

mgmplushits.us.title: Back to School
mgmplushits.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy) - 1986

mgmplushits.us.title: The Passenger
mgmplushits.us.description: Randy is perfectly content to fade into the background, but when one of his co-workers goes on a sudden and violent rampage, he must face his fears and confront his troubled past to survive. (Thriller, Drama) - 2023

mgmplushits.us.title: Apache
mgmplushits.us.description: Adapted from the 1936 novel Bronco Apache, this groundbreaking Western casts a sympathetic eye on the struggles of Native Americans in the post-bellum West. Massai, the only Apache warrior still fighting after the surrender of Geronimo, is arrested and placed on a train headed for a Florida prison. After a daring escape, he begins the trip back home to his lover, Nalinle, on foot -- but the journey is long and treacherous, and the authorities are closing in. (Western) - 1954

mgmplushits.us.title: Hondo
mgmplushits.us.description: An embittered Indian scout attempts to escort a homesteader's wife and her son back to safety after her cowardly husband deserts her during an Apache attack. When she refuses to go, the scout stays on to help for a while and, over time, forms a strong bond with both her and her son. (Western, Drama, Romance, War) - 1953

mgmplushits.us.title: Sex Life - Dungeons and Unicorns
mgmplushits.us.description: Swinging by a lifestyle party; enjoying the intense burlesque of Michelle L'amour; looking behind the curtain at an L.A. dungeon. (Adults only, Erotic, Documentary) - 2019-07-12

mgmplushits.us.title: Smurfs
mgmplushits.us.description: When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2025

mgmplushits.us.title: The Missouri Breaks
mgmplushits.us.description: When vigilante land baron David Braxton (John McLiam) hangs one of the best friends of cattle rustler Tom Logan (Jack Nicholson), Logan's gang decides to get even by purchasing a small farm next to Braxton's ranch. From there the rustlers begin stealing horses, using the farm as a front for their operation. Determined to stop the thefts at any cost, Braxton retains the services of eccentric sharpshooter Robert E. Lee Clayton (Marlon Brando), who begins ruthlessly taking down Logan's gang. (Western, Drama) - 1976

He becomes involved in the life of the mysterious Jay Gatsby (Robert Redford), a rich man who throws the most lavish parties on the island. But behind Gatsby's outgoing demeanor is a lonely man who wants nothing more than to be with his old love, Daisy (Mia Farrow). She is married to the bullheaded Tom (Bruce Dern), creating a love triangle that will end in tragedy. (Drama) - 1974

nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin encourages Simon to write a frank email in 'Un-send!', then in 'The Orb', when Simon notices that Theodore has a hard time saying no, he creates the "No-Buddy". (S2, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.description: The boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter in 'Temporary Mom', then in 'Tee For Two', Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and gets paired up with Miss Smith. (S3, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The chipmunks think Dave is in danger in 'The Exchange Student', then in 'Crystal Ball Birthday', Annie and Amber plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor. (S4, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results in 'Fire Safety', then in 'Castle Catstrophe', Cheesy and Alvin cause an accident at a historic castle. (S5, ep 12)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Dave is concerned that The Chipmunks are obsessed with a video game in 'Mystic Mountain', and in 'Candy Confessions', Alvin wants a skateboard, but Theodore uses the money to buy sweets. (S1, ep 11)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Alvin accidentally clones himself in 'Double Trouble', then in 'Liar Liar', Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web. (S2, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: The boys accidently break Dave's new flat screen TV in 'The Fugitives', and in 'Sherlock Chipmunk', Jeanette and Eleanor act as Sherlock Holmes and Watson when Theodore's teddy disappears. (S3, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
nicktoons.uk.description: Theodore mistakenly thinks he's the oldest brother in 'Big Bro Theodore', and in 'No Putts, No Glory', Alvin fools Theodore into believing he's good at mini golf which of course backfires. (S4, ep 10)

nicktoons.uk.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
