skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wicked: For Good
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Golden Compass
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In a parallel universe, a young girl called Lyra comes into possession of a magical compass that is the beginning of an epic quest to save her world.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Charlie Bucket comes from a poor family, and spends most of his time dreaming about the chocolate that he loves but usually can't afford. Things change when Willy Wonka, head of the very popular Wonka Chocolate empire, announces a contest in which five gold tickets have been hidden in chocolate bars. Charlie is one of the five kids who find a lucky ticket and goes on a tour of Wonka's chocolate factory.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Small Soldiers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A New York couple go to an orphanage to adopt a brother for their only son, but instead come away with a little mouse. On arrival at his new home, the diminutive rodent receives a lukewarm welcome by the boy - and an even frostier reception from the pet cat. Featuring a mixture of live action and animation.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Stuart Little 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Sequel to the children's story about the adventures of a small mouse, blending live action and computer-animated characters. The eponymous hero befriends a tiny bird wounded by a sinister falcon, but he must enlist the help of the dreaded family cat if he is to protect his new-found friend.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Liar Liar
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Annie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Daddy Warbucks opens his estate to a spunky orphan in this adaptation of the popular comic strip and hit Broadway show.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
skycinemafamily.uk.description: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
skycinemafamily.uk.description: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Spoof spy caper with the eponymous, blundering hero attempting to recover the crown jewels and save Britain from an evil mastermind when all the other agents are killed. Promoted from lowly pen pusher to super spy, Johnny English is baffled when clues lead to respected entrepreneur Pascal Sauvage, but could the enigmatic Lorna hold the key to the mystery?

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Reborn
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A haphazard spy returns to MI-7 after years in a Tibetan monastery honing his Zen skills. Armed with gizmos, gadgets and chaotic luck he takes on a global ring of assassins.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Johnny English Strikes Again
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Johnny English springs back into action when a hacker reveals the identities of undercover agents in Britain. As a man with few skills and analogue methods, Johnny must overcome the challenges of modern technology to make this mission a success.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When a single mother and her two children move to a new town, they soon discover that they have a connection to the original Ghostbusters and their grandfather's secret legacy.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jack the Giant Slayer
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A young farmhand gets swept into the realm of legend when he must defend his land from a seemingly unstoppable force of giant warriors.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: Reincarnated as different dogs over the course of five decades, a lovable and devoted canine keeps reuniting with the original owner who cared for it as a young golden retriever puppy.

Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

All seems well until Michael discovers Madison's whereabouts and re-creates her nightmare. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1997

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Heart Specialist
shoxbetwest.us.description: After following a former girlfriend to Florida, Ray Howard (Brian J. White) winds up as an intern in a not-so-prestigious teaching hospital. An unapologetic Lothario, Ray tries to work his charms on nurse Donna (Zoe Saldana), but she's already involved with the chief resident, Dr. Sidney Zachary (Wood Harris), who is also Ray's instructor. Sidney, who moonlights as a standup comic, decides that Ray needs to learn about true love, as well as medicine. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

(Special, Documentary, Music, Hip-Hop & rap) - 2021-12-03

starz.us.description: A beautiful cheerleader (Megan Fox) gains an insatiable appetite for human flesh after a hungry demon takes control of her body. (Horror, Comedy) - 2009

starz.us.title: Paranormal Activity
starz.us.description: Soon after moving into a suburban tract home, Katie (Katie Featherston) and Micah (Micah Sloat) become increasingly disturbed by what appears to be a supernatural presence. Hoping to capture evidence of it on film, they set up video cameras in the house but are not prepared for the terrifying events that follow. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2007

starz.us.title: Paranormal Activity 2
starz.us.description: When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next. (Horror, Thriller) - 2010

starz.us.title: Haunted Heist
starz.us.description: When a reunion at a creepy mansion turns into a robbery, four friends discover the owners -- ghosts from the 1950s -- have never left. They soon find themselves battling supernatural terrors as the evil spirits plan a demonic sacrifice. (Comedy, Horror) - 2025

starz.us.title: Ride Along 2
starz.us.description: Rookie lawman Ben Barber (Kevin Hart) aspires to become a detective like James Payton (Ice Cube), his future brother-in-law. James reluctantly takes Ben to Miami to follow up on a lead that's connected to a drug ring. The case brings them to a homicide detective and a computer hacker who reveals evidence that implicates a respected businessman. It's now up to James and Ben to prove that charismatic executive Antonio Pope is actually a violent crime lord who rules southern Florida's drug trade. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

starz.us.title: The Man in the White Van
starz.us.description: In the 1970s Florida, a driver in a white van follows a young girl seemingly everywhere she goes. As the menace escalates, her parents dismiss her fears, leading to a terrifying Halloween nightmare that shatters her world. (Holiday, Thriller) - 2023

starz.us.description: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network, his only ally is Navin, a journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. starz.us.title: Ant-Man
starz.us.description: Forced out of his own company by former protégé Darren Cross, Dr. Hank Pym recruits the talents of Scott Lang, a master thief just released from prison. Lang becomes Ant-Man, trained by Pym and armed with a suit that allows him to shrink in size, possess superhuman strength and control an army of ants. The miniature hero must use his new skills to prevent Cross, also known as Yellowjacket, from perfecting the same technology and using it as a weapon for evil. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Comedy) - 2015

starz.us.title: Clueless
starz.us.description: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

starz.us.title: Baby Mama
starz.us.description: When single executive Kate Holbrook (Tina Fey) decides the time is right to finally have a baby, she hires a working-class woman (Amy Poehler) from South Philadelphia to act as her surrogate mother. However, Kate's careful planning goes out the window when the woman shows up on her doorstep needing a place to live. A comic battle of wills breaks out between the pair as they prepare for the blessed event and try not to kill one another in the process. (Comedy) - 2008

starz.us.title: Sisters
starz.us.description: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles. (Comedy) - 2015

Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor. (Action, Adventure, Historical drama) - 2011

starzencoreaction.us.title: Sahara
starzencoreaction.us.description: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. (Adventure, Action) - 2005

starzencoreblack.us.title: Dead Man Running
starzencoreblack.us.description: Nick borrows money from a loan shark. When he's four weeks behind on the repayments, he gets 24 hours to come up with 100,000 pounds as his mom is held hostage. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2009

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Last Face

Wren (Charlize Theron) is the spokesperson for an organization that funds medical assistance for impoverished nations the world over. They meet in Liberia, where Wren is immediately impressed with Miguel's selflessness, medical skill and charm. They begin a torrid affair, one they must learn to balance with their important work. (Drama) - 2016

starzencoreblack.us.title: Cradle 2 the Grave
starzencoreblack.us.description: Master thief Anthony Fait (DMX) pulls off a major jewel heist and somehow manages to escape from the SWAT team that's pursuing him. A Taiwanese agent named Su (Jet Li) is on Fait's tail and wants to take him down so that he can retrieve the stolen black diamonds. But when Fait's daughter (Paige Hurd) is kidnapped by a rival criminal and Su's ex-partner (Mark Dacascos), Su must work with Fait to save the thief's daughter and get his revenge in the process. (Action, Thriller) - 2003

starzencoreblack.us.title: The Wood
starzencoreblack.us.description: Three old friends -- Mike (Omar Epps), Roland (Taye Diggs) and Slim (Richard T. Jones) -- recount memories of their shared childhood in Inglewood, Calif., as they prepare for Roland's wedding to his fiancée, Lisa (LisaRaye). When the groom goes missing without a word, Mike and Slim struggle to find their nervous friend and return him to his impatient bride before the wedding begins. Along the way, they continue to swap stories about lessons learned during their awkward teenage years. (Drama) - 1999

starzencoreblack.us.title: Code Name: The Cleaner
starzencoreblack.us.description: When Jake (Cedric the Entertainer) awakes one morning in a strange hotel room, he finds himself in a bit of a predicament; there's a corpse in his bed and a briefcase full of cash. Not only that, but he cannot remember who he is or how he got there. He meets Gina (Lucy Liu), a waitress, who tells him he is a janitor at a video-game company and that she is a girlfriend. But Jake believes he is an undercover agent for the CIA, and he tries to figure out the truth. (Comedy, Action) - 2007

starzencoreblack.us.title: Krystal
starzencoreblack.us.description: A sheltered young man joins Alcoholics Anonymous to get closer to the woman of his dreams, a former hooker and stripper named Krystal. (Comedy drama) - 2017

starzencoreblack.us.title: Ride Along
starzencoreblack.us.description: For two years, security guard Ben has tried to convince James, a veteran cop, that he is worthy of James' sister, Angela. When Ben is finally accepted into the police academy, James decides to test his mettle by inviting him along on a shift deliberately designed to scare the trainee. However, events take an unexpected turn when their wild night leads to Atlanta's most-notorious criminal and Ben's rapid-fire mouth proves as dangerous as the bullets whizzing by them. (Comedy, Action) - 2014

starzencoreblack.us.title: Ride Along 2
starzencoreblack.us.description: Rookie lawman Ben Barber (Kevin Hart) aspires to become a detective like James Payton (Ice Cube), his future brother-in-law. James reluctantly takes Ben to Miami to follow up on a lead that's connected to a drug ring. The case brings them to a homicide detective and a computer hacker who reveals evidence that implicates a respected businessman. It's now up to James and Ben to prove that charismatic executive Antonio Pope is actually a violent crime lord who rules southern Florida's drug trade. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

starzencoreblack.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzencoreblack.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story. (Action, Comedy drama) - 2013

starzencoreblack.us.title: Scary Movie 2
starzencoreblack.us.description: All the scary movie characters are back in a laugh packed sequel that scares up even more irreverent fun than the original. Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris lead a stellar cast that takes extreme pleasure in skewering Hollywood's most frightening feature films and spoofing popular culture. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit. (Comedy, Horror) - 2001

Though they don't know each other very well, Nina confides in Jose that she is pregnant and considering an abortion. Understanding that Nina is going through a tough time, Jose invites her to his home. They spend the day together and tell each other their most painful secrets, and what Nina learns about Jose changes her life forever. (Drama) - 2006

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Idlewild
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A reticent piano player, named Percival (André Benjamin), along with Rooster (Antwan A. Patton), his flamboyant lead performer and manager, struggle to keep their speakeasy, in the Prohibition-era South, out of the hands of gangsters who want to take it over. (Drama, Musical) - 2006

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Clueless
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Sisters
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles. (Comedy) - 2015

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Mariah Carey: Merry Christmas to All!
starzencoreclassic.us.description: The singer-songwriter performs a repertoire of her festive holiday hits, including the chart-topping perennial favorite "All I Want for Christmas Is You." (Holiday, Special, Entertainment, Music) - 2022-12-20

starzencoreclassic.us.title: It Waits
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Terror strikes a young woman (Cerina Vincent) and her boyfriend (Dominic Zamprogna) when archaeology students unwittingly unleash a demon from a cave. (Horror) - 2005

starzencoreclassic.us.title: One Man's Justice
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When the wife and daughter of Army drill sergeant John North (Brian Bosworth) are killed during an arms deal involving a crooked FBI agent named Karl Savak (Bruce Payne), John decides to take matters into his own hands, only to discover that the henchman responsible for their deaths has been put into witness protection. Now, John must enlist the help of a street-smart kid named Mikey (DeJuan Guy) to infiltrate the city's criminal underground and get his own form of revenge. (Action) - 1995

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Crave
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Aiden yearns for a better life and to get away from his grisly job as a crime scene photographer. As his dark imagination leaks into reality, he meets a younger woman with her own problems and begins to live out his vigilante fantasies. (Drama, Thriller) - 2012

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Hemingway's Garden of Eden

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Deliver Us From Evil
starzencoreclassic.us.description: As a veteran member of a South Bronx precinct, NYPD Sgt. Ralph Sarchie (Eric Bana) has seen more than his share of dark and horrifying events -- so many that they have begun to poison his soul. Sarchie further finds his beliefs and understanding pushed to the limit when he and his partner investigate a particularly bizarre incident. He forms an alliance with a renegade priest (Edgar Ramírez), who tries to convince Sarchie that real evil -- and demons -- do exist. (Horror, Thriller) - 2014

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Win a Date With Tad Hamilton!
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Pete (Topher Grace), the quirky, self-deprecating manager of a grocery store, is madly in love with his best friend, Rosalee (Kate Bosworth). Unfortunately, she has absolutely no idea. When Rosalee wins a date with her favorite actor, the smarmy Tad Hamilton (Josh Duhamel), Pete delays admitting his feelings to her. And when the scheming Hamilton relocates to their small town to pursue Rosalee in the wake of their initial meeting, a horrified Pete must struggle to win her heart. (Romance, Comedy, Adventure) - 2004

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Back-up Plan
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Hard Word

Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. themoviechannel.us.description: Talented getaway driver Baby relies on the beat of his personal soundtrack to be the best in the game. After meeting the woman of his dreams, he sees a chance to ditch his shady lifestyle and make a clean break. Coerced into working for a crime boss, Baby must face the music as a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
themoviechannel.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
themoviechannel.us.description: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: Marathon Man
themoviechannel.us.description: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War) - 1976

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Primal Fear
themoviechannel.us.description: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect. (Crime drama, Thriller) - 1996

themoviechannel.us.title: Kiss the Girls
themoviechannel.us.description: Successful forensic psychologist Alex Cross (Morgan Freeman) discovers that his niece has gone missing. Once he consults with police Detective Nick Ruskin (Cary Elwes), Cross believes that the disappearance is the work of an insane killer known as "Casanova." Meanwhile, Dr. Kate McTiernan (Ashley Judd) is kidnapped by this criminal and witnesses many other imprisoned women in his lair. After narrowly escaping, McTiernan teams up with Cross to try to apprehend the deranged Casanova. (Mystery, Thriller, Crime drama) - 1997

themoviechannel.us.title: The Lovely Bones
themoviechannel.us.description: After being brutally murdered, 14-year-old Susie Salmon (Saoirse Ronan) watches from heaven over her grief-stricken family (Mark Wahlberg, Rachel Weisz) -- and her killer (Stanley Tucci). As she observes their daily lives, she must balance her thirst for revenge with her desire for her family to heal. (Drama, Mystery, Fantasy, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Gift
themoviechannel.us.description: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit. (Thriller, Mystery) - 2000

themoviechannel.us.title: Organ Trail
themoviechannel.us.description: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits. (Western, Horror, Thriller) - 2023

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
themoviechannel.us.description: Ex-con Jimmy Cuervo (Edward Furlong) and his girlfriend (Emmanuelle Chriqui) are targeted by satanists, who murder them as part of a ceremony to resurrect the devil. However, a crow brings Jimmy back, and as an invulnerable spirit of justice, he begins hunting down his murderers. While the satanists meet grisly ends one at a time, the leaders, Luc Death Crash (David Boreanaz) and his lover, Lola (Tara Reid), attempt to complete the ritual, which will make them even more powerful than Jimmy. (Fantasy) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: The Prophecy: Forsaken
themoviechannel.us.description: A lawman (Jason Scott Lee) tries to protect a young woman (Kari Wuhrer) who possesses a book that inhabitants of heaven and hell want. (Horror, Thriller) - 2005

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane!
themoviechannel.us.description: This spoof comedy takes shots at the slew of disaster movies that were released in the 70s. When the passengers and crew of a jet are incapacitated due to food poisoning, a rogue pilot with a drinking problem must cooperate with his ex-girlfriend turned stewardess to bring the plane to a safe landing. (Dark comedy) - 1980

themoviechannel.us.title: Airplane II: The Sequel
themoviechannel.us.description: Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. But, as soon as Mayflower One lifts off, an electrical malfunction sends the ship veering off course. A shaken Striker struggles to guide the shuttle through a treacherous asteroid belt, tame its failing computer systems and stop the disgruntled Joe Seluchi (Sonny Bono) from detonating a deadly bomb on board. (Science fiction, Dark comedy) - 1982

themoviechannel.us.title: Carriers
themoviechannel.us.description: When a virus threatens to wipe out humanity, Danny (Lou Taylor Pucci), his brother Brian (Chris Pine), and their friends Bobby (Piper Perabo) and Kate (Emily VanCamp) set out across the desert in the Southwest, trying to elude the pandemic. Over the course of several days, the four friends learn that the darkness within themselves may prove deadlier than any microbe. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Every Breath You Take
themoviechannel.us.description: A psychiatrist's life gets turned upside down when a patient takes her own life, and he introduces her brother to his own family. (Thriller) - 2021

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: The Firm
themoviechannel.us.description: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty. (Drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

themoviechannel.us.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
themoviechannel.us.description: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own. (Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery, Romance) - 1999

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Secret Fury
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The wedding of Ellen (Claudette Colbert) and David (Robert Ryan) is halted by a stranger who insists that the bride is already married to someone else. Though the flabbergasted Ellen denies the charge, the interloper produces enough evidence that his accusation must be investigated. Ellen and David travel to the small coastal town where her first wedding allegedly occurred. There, they meet a number of individuals whose stories make Ellen question her own sanity. (Mystery) - 1950

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Shadow of Doubt
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When a Hollywood producer is murdered, the most likely suspect is a man who is smitten with the victim's fiancée. (Mystery) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: 100 Rifles
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Greatest
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Boxer Cassius Clay (Muhammad Ali) trains with Angelo Dundee (Ernest Borgnine), becomes heavyweight champion and converts to Islam. (Biography) - 1977

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Black Eye
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An ex-police officer operating a private detective business comes face to face with a syndicate-backed dope ring. (Action) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Black Belt Jones
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A martial artist (Jim Kelly) helps a father (Scatman Crothers) and daughter (Gloria Hendry) save their school of self-defense from Los Angeles mobsters. (Adventure, Martial arts) - 1974

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Hit Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An avenger (Bernie Casey) wades through the Los Angeles porno underworld in the name of his dead brother. (Action, Crime drama) - 1972

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: MGM Parade Show
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Cain and Mabel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A chorus girl (Marion Davies) and a heavyweight boxer (Clark Gable) are paired romantically as a publicity stunt. (Musical comedy) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Brother Rat and a Baby
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Cadets Dan Crawford (Ronald Reagan), Billy Randolph (Wayne Morris) and Bing Edwards (Eddie Albert) have graduated from the Virginia Military Institute. In commemoration of this accomplishment, Bing and his loving wife, Kate (Jane Bryan), name their firstborn child Commencement. But, despite the enthusiasm of the graduates, they soon discover that life after school is trickier than they expected -- especially with a trouble-making baby that goes missing. (Comedy) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Susan and God
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Susan Trexel returns home from Europe, bursting to share her spiritual transformation with her friends. Although Susan's estranged husband, Barrie, pleads for a reunion, Susan goes to stay with a friend and, acting upon her certainty that everyone can benefit from the truth, begins meddling in the lives of her friend's family. Barrie convinces Susan to act on her own beliefs and give him and their daughter, Blossom, another chance, but Susan remains smugly aloof. (Comedy drama) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Damon and Pythias
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Greek tyrant Dionysius puts the friendship of two men (Don Burnett, Guy Williams) to a life-or-death test. (Historical drama) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Abbott and Costello in Hollywood
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two bumbling barbers (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) act as agents for an unknown singer and stage a phony murder to get him a coveted role. (Comedy) - 1945

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Judge Hardy and Son
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An elderly woman (Maria Ouspenskaya) and her husband are on the verge of eviction, and seek the advice of Judge Hardy (Lewis Stone) on how to keep their home. Hardy is led to believe the couple had a daughter who can help them in their predicament, but he needs to find her first. The judge tasks his son, Andy (Mickey Rooney), with the search, which leads to some unfortunate events for the boy -- although Andy's problems seem less important when Mrs. Hardy (Fay Holden) falls ill. (Comedy) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bonnie and Clyde
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Small-time crook Clyde Barrow (Warren Beatty) tries to steal a car and winds up with its owner's daughter, dissatisfied small-town girl Bonnie Parker (Faye Dunaway). Their crimes quickly spiral from petty theft to bank robbery, but tensions between the couple and the other members of their gang--hapless driver C.W. (Michael J. Pollard), Clyde's suave older brother Buck (Gene Hackman) and Buck's flibbertigibbet wife, Blanche (Estelle Parsons) --could destroy them all. (Crime drama) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Tarzan and His Mate
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Englishman Harry Holt (Neil Hamilton) joins a friend for an African safari on which they hope to find ivory. Holt also hopes to locate former girlfriend Jane Parker (Maureen O'Sullivan) who lives with her husband, Tarzan (Johnny Weissmuller), a white man raised by animals in the jungle. When they find the couple, Jane refuses Holt's overtures. As Holt and his companion continue their search for an ancient elephant burial ground, they unleash havoc from all the jungle's inhabitants. (Adventure) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Beguiled
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Offbeat Civil War drama in which a wounded Yankee soldier, after finding refuge in an isolated girls' school in the South towards the end of the war, becomes the object of the young women's sexual fantasies. The soldier manipulates the situation for his own gratification, but when he refuses to completely comply with the girls' wishes, they make it very difficult for him to leave. (Historical drama) - 1971

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Sentinel
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A New York City model with a troubled past, Alison Parker decides to make some changes in her life. Breaking up with her boyfriend, Michael, Alison relocates to an apartment in a brownstone building where the only other tenant is a withdrawn blind priest. After experiencing strange occurrences, Alison begins to realize why the holy man is present -- the building has an evil presence that must be kept in check at all costs. (Horror) - 1977

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: I Walked With a Zombie
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Canadian nurse Betsy Connell (Frances Dee) is hired to care for Jessica Holland (Christine Gordon), a woman on a Caribbean sugar plantation, who has a bizarre condition. The mysterious affliction baffles Betsy but when she falls for Jessica's husband, Paul (Tom Conway), she is determined to make him happy by curing his wife. However, in her quest, Betsy is drawn into the island's dark culture of voodoo and zombies and begins to uncover the Holland family's sinister secrets. (Horror) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bedlam
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After getting a glimpse of the conditions at the St. Mary's of Bethlehem Asylum, known as "Bedlam," Nell Bowen (Anna Lee) is concerned that the patients are being mistreated. When she seeks to better the situation, the head of St. Mary's, George Sims (Boris Karloff), uses his political savvy to have Nell committed. Being within St. Mary's does not deter Nell, however, and she starts to turn the patients against Sims in a bid to violently oust him from power. (Horror) - 1946

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Carnival of Souls
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Mary Henry ends up the sole survivor of a fatal car accident through mysterious circumstances. Trying to put the incident behind her, she moves to Utah and takes a job as a church organist. But her fresh start is interrupted by visions of a fiendish man. As the visions begin to occur more frequently, Mary finds herself drawn to the deserted carnival on the outskirts of town. The strangely alluring carnival may hold the secret to her tragic past. (Horror) - 1962

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Corridors of Blood
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Determined to develop a gaseous drug that allows patients to tolerate the difficulties of surgery, Dr. Bolton (Boris Karloff) devises numerous opium-based remedies, which he tests on himself. His experiments fail miserably in trials performed for his colleagues -- who include his own son, Jonathan (Francis Matthews) -- and Bolton is dismissed from his position. Having developed an addiction to opium, Bolton finds work treating the poor but falls in with grave robbers in order to get drugs. (Horror) - 1958

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Black Cats and Broomsticks
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Examining the role of superstitions, personal rituals, taboos, talismans and the black arts in mid-20th century America. (Documentary) - 1955

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: George Hall and His Orchestra
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: George Hall and his orchestra are stranded and decide to sleep on the stage of a potentially haunted theater in this short film. (Special, Music, Musical)

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dr. Crippen
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In 1910 London, Dr. Hawley Harvey Crippen (Donald Pleasence) stands trial for the murder of his wife (Coral Browne). (Crime drama, Historical drama) - 1963

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Chamber of Horrors
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Psychotic Jason Cravatte (Patrick O'Neal) murders a woman, and then coerces a priest into wedding him to his dead bride. He is soon caught and sentenced to death by the police. Fascinated by the gruesome tale, Anthony Draco (Cesare Danova) and Harold Blount (Wilfrid Hyde-White) decide to install a diorama in their wax museum depicting the story. But when Cravatte escapes, swearing death to all those he feels have wronged him, Draco and Blount will have to think quickly to escape his wrath. (Horror) - 1966

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Spider Baby
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Chauffeur Bruno (Lon Chaney Jr.) looks after three strange siblings at their family estate. Ralph (Sid Haig), Virginia (Jill Banner) and Elizabeth (Beverly Washburn) all suffer from an inherited condition: a genetic disorder that causes a reversal in mental age and results in a crazed, childlike disposition. Because of his affection for the family, Bruno covers up the siblings' bizarre behavior and crimes. But, when relatives arrive at the family estate, the truth is bound to come out. (Horror, Comedy) - 1967

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: White Zombie
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Murder Legendre is the menacingly named zombie master of Haiti. Charles Beaumont goes to him when he needs help for a twisted plan. Spurned in marriage by Madeline Short, Beaumont has decided on a simple solution: kill Short and bring her back as a zombie. Then he can be with her forever. The only problem comes when Legendre keeps the fetching girl for himself -- and her new husband comes to Madeline's rescue. (Horror, Thriller, Romance) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Walking Dead
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: An executed convict returns from the grave to revenge himself against the gangsters who framed him for murder. (Horror, Thriller) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mad Love
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Grand Guignol theater actress Yvonne Orlac is married to concert pianist Stephen and plans to take a break from acting to tour with him. However, Dr. Gogol, her biggest fan, won't let her go so easily. When Stephen's hands are destroyed in an accident, Dr. Gogol's obsession with Yvonne leads him to replace Stephen's hands with those of a knife-wielding murderer who was sentenced to death. Soon, Stephen's new hands develop a mind of their own. (Science fiction) - 1935

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Eyes Without a Face
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's. (Horror, Drama) - 1960

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Haunting
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Dr. John Markway, an anthropologist with an interest in psychic phenomena, takes two specially selected women to Hill House, a reportedly haunted mansion. Eleanor (Julie Harris), a lonely, eccentric woman with a supernatural event in her past, and the bold Theodora (Claire Bloom), who has ESP, join John and the mansion's heir, cynical Luke (Russ Tamblyn). They are immediately overwhelmed by strange sounds and events, and Eleanor comes to believe the house is alive and speaking directly to her. (Horror) - 1963

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E10 Pyramids of Mars: Part 2 The Doctor, Sarah and Laurence Scarman are being hunted down by Sutekh’s robot mummies. The Doctor has a plan disrupt Sutekh’s control signal, but will it work?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E12 Pyramids of Mars: Part 4 Inside the pyramid on Mars, the Doctor and Sarah must solve puzzles and escape traps to prevent Sutekh’s release from his imprisonment – but are they too late?

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E4 Terror of the Zygons: Part 4 The Zygon warlord, Broton, disguised as the Duke of Forgill, intends to use the Skarasen to attack the World Energy Conference in London.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E18 The Brain of Morbius: Part 2 The Doctor is a prisoner of the Sisterhood of Karn who intend to burn him at the stake. Sarah hurries to the Doctor’s rescue but pays the price for her efforts.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E19 The Brain of Morbius: Part 3 Sarah has been blinded and the Doctor asks the Sisterhood for help. Morbius, fearful that the Time Lords have tracked him down, tells Solon to install his brain in a new body.

BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E20 The Brain of Morbius: Part 4 Morbius, housed in a terrifying new body, lives and breathes once more and the Doctor is forced to challenge his foe to a deadly mental duel which only one of them will survive.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E21 The Seeds of Doom: Part 1 When the Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic, he and Sarah rush to investigate. But they are too late. A man is already turning into a Krynoid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E22 The Seeds of Doom: Part 2 The Krynoid is on the loose in the arctic. Scorby and Keeler have been sent to steal the alien pod and are willing to resort to murder to cover their tracks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E23 The Seeds of Doom: Part 3 The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod to the estate of Harrison Chase. The millionaire botanist intends use the pod to change a human victim into a Krynoid.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E24 The Seeds of Doom: Part 4 Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid. Chase refuses to listen to the Doctor’s warning and throws him into a compost machine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E25 The Seeds of Doom: Part 5 The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it. But the Doctor escapes to seek help. Sarah and Scorby, still trapped on the estate, battle against the living plants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S13 E26 The Seeds of Doom: Part 6 The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase. Outside the Krynoid prepares to germinate, sending its deadly seed pods out across the land.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E9 Buddy Day The cadets pair up with a Junior Junior Cadet to show the importance of always swimming with a buddy, but Frizzy gets carried away with the theatrics of it all and forgets what it takes to be a good buddy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ninjago ᴺᵉʷ
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E6 Kingdom Come In Cloud Kingdom, a realm where destinies are written, the Ninja must get the Sword of Sanctuary, a powerful relic that can see past the traps surrounding the tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E8 The Beginning of the End Merlin is forced to choose between a young Druid's life and his destiny to protect Arthur.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E17 The New Wand Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill, Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E9 The Terror Of Tenoo The Jedi discover a long lost ship.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks

ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E8 Jumble Stephen Fry looks into a jumble of things that start with the letter 'J'. Guests this week are Jo Brand, John Sessions, Dara O Briain and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S18 E5 Episode 5 Rob Brydon hosts the award-winning comedy panel show with Lee Mack and David Mitchell. Sorting the fact from the fiction are Richie Anderson, Katharine Parkinson, Taj Atwal and Chris McCausland.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters
ABCMESydney.au.description: S5 E13 Episode 16 It’s the viewer special sequel, sequel! Yup the viewer inspired ideas just keep on coming and in this jam packed episode the guys tackle four of the best fan fables in their inboxes.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S8 E4 West Sussex George meets Becky and Joe, who plan to build their home on the back of an old trailer. Will meets single mum Maria, who tackles transforming a battered old military helicopter into a super-cool aeronautical party pad.

ABCMESydney.au.title: House of Games ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E20 Episode 20 Dev Griffin, Alex Horne, Debbie McGee and June Sarpong test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spicks and Specks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S12 E9 Robert Forster, Julia Morris, Ruva Ngwenya & Brett Blake Gardening Australia's Costa Georgiadis joins for a fun new game and there to help spread the lawn fertiliser are Robert Forster, Julia Morris, Ruva Ngwenya and Brett Blake. Plus Pseudo Echo takes us back to Funky Town.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S13 E13 Lucky Losers Stephen Fry takes a quite interesting look at luck and loss. Jeremy Clarkson, Sandi Toksvig, Danny Baker and Alan Davies are the panel hoping to be fortunate enough to avoid failure.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S15 E11 The Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for an episode of previously unseen material. A stellar cast of celebrity guests reveal extraordinary stories about themselves. But are they true, or are they making it all up?

ABCMESydney.au.title: Planet America
ABCMESydney.au.description: E33 With just over one week to go until the Midterm Elections, Chas and John bring you the state of the races, the key battlegrounds to watch, the latest polls and controversies as American voters decide who'll control Congress.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Along Came A Spider ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal kidnaps a senator's young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

ABCMESydney.au.title: ER
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E3 Don't Ask, Don't Tell While the new Chief of Staff's strict rules annoy everyone, Carter makes an error in judgment, Benton starts work as a paediatric surgeon, Susan asks Mark to go on vacation with her to Hawaii, and a new intern joins the ER.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Not Going Out
ABCMESydney.au.description: S9 E3 Stolen When their son's toy keyring goes missing, Lee and Lucy blame Anna and Toby's son Jack, who denies the theft. Lee takes it upon himself to retrieve the keyring with truly embarrassing results.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Like A Version - triple j ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E46 triple j's legendary Like A Version segment hosts the greatest local and international acts, performing a cover of a song they love, and one of their own.

ABCMESydney.au.title: rage Charts ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: E303 Episode 303 Australia's longest running music TV show, rage is home to the biggest vault of music videos from a diverse range of artists, genres and eras. We curate the best clips of all time to surprise and entertain you for hours.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E5 Zoe and Danny follow a rogue scientist who's potentially involved in biochemical warfare.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year

ABCMESydney.au.title: Penn & Teller: Fool Us
ABCMESydney.au.description: S7 E10 Deep Fake Penn The magicians featured in the episode include Boris Wild, Ramo & Alegria, Jonio and Dr. Ricardo Rosenkranz.

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI
ABCMESydney.au.description: S11 E8 Jumble Stephen Fry looks into a jumble of things that start with the letter 'J'. Guests this week are Jo Brand, John Sessions, Dara O Briain and Alan Davies.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Powerpuff Girls
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E33 The Squashening The Girls must tell a monster a scary story.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E3 Witches Brew The Titans throw a Halloween party and invite the Justice League, but the witches brew that Robin creates has a few side effects.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E8 Vampigami Afraid Adrien won't love her anymore if she doesn't go to the movies with him, Marinette agrees to attend the screening of a horror movie with him. Marinette's worst fear!

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Strange Chores
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Don't Trick or Tweet Defending the house on Halloween, Charlie's in for a fright when Pierce invites the neighbourhood (and at least one monster) over for a costume party. They must trick the gatecrasher to reveal itself before it gets its treat!

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Strange Chores
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E15 Haunt The House When Que's ghostly face goes viral, Charlie is ready to cash in on her fame. But Pierce fears what all this exposure could lead to.

ABCMESydney.au.title: 100% Wolf: Legend of the Moonstone
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E7 Howloween It's Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Badjelly
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Separation Anxiety Badjelly and Dulboot get a taste of what life would be like without each other, and one of them does not like it.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E20 Pumpkin Peril It's the night before Halloween and Bitzer is charged with guarding the Farmer's 3 prize pumpkins. Despite Shaun and the flock's best efforts, the pumpkins mysteriously disappear, leaving nothing but a trail of ghostly slime.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Moominvalley
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E9 Night of the Groke Moomintroll's mind starts to play tricks on him when he's left home alone overnight for the first time. But his worst fears are realised with the appearance of an all-too-real, nightmarish creature - The Groke!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E7 Halloween The gang goes trick or treating on Halloween night but Velma seems to think that Halloween is a disrespect to history while Daphne, Shaggy and Scooby have the opposite opinion.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E12 Halloween Raven is disappointed that the other Teen Titans don't care for Halloween, so she tries to return the spirit to the holiday.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mystery Lane
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E25 The Spy of Buckingham The Queen in person comes to see Clever for an ultra-confidential mission. The previous night, her secret agent 'C', tried to join her to warn her of an imminent danger but then disappeared mysteriously.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Summer Camp Island
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E8 Ghost the Boy Oscar and Hedgehog befriend a ghost who can't remember who he is.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Ghastly Ghoul
ABCMESydney.au.description: A little monster from Halloween World is stranded in the human world on Halloween Night after trick or treating too much, and it's up to one girl to face her fears and help the monster return home.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Little Lunch Specials
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E1 The Halloween Horror Story When Atticus' mother gets a job overseas, he discovers that the day of the Halloween school play will be his last day of school. Suddenly Halloween doesn't seem scary, but leaving his friends, especially Rory, is terrifying.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E02 Deadly Deception The murder of Jamie Faith appears to be a random street shooting until investigators uncover fake identities, thousands of messages and murderous manipulation; prosecutors must prove how a long-distance relationship led to murder in Dallas.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E03 The Tourniquet Killer When DNA breaks open a decades-old cold case, Kelly Siegler finds herself prosecuting one of the most intelligent killers she has ever faced. What begins with one victim exposes the crimes of a monstrous serial killer who escaped justice for years.

oxygenwest.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E04 Triangle of Guilt A young woman vanishes after a night out in Dallas, leading investigators to the home of an aspiring rapper in a twisted love triangle; following an international manhunt, prosecutors must prove who killed her with no weapon or cause of death.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S09 E12 Evil Was Waiting Vince Goslyn's military career was thriving, and he had built a beautiful family; one night, the father of five was gunned down.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S13 E10 Evil Paid a Visit Eleven years after Connecticut mother Donna Palomba is raped in her home, investigators finally track down her attacker; Donna speaks out about the case, including her fight to keep her assailant from walking free.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E12 Haunting Police believe a pair of double homicides in Nebraska, five years apart, might be connected; investigators working to solve the crimes fear the killer might strike again.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S16 E08 A Deal With the Devil A notorious serial killer, nicknamed Hannibal, murders several people while working as a confidential informant for the FBI.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E01 Devil's Bathtub Craig and Laura Rideout appear happy, but after they separate, an ugly secret is revealed and one of them will soon be dead; clues point to four possible killers and leave investigators wondering if this murder is all in the family.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 A Hopeless Romantic A young mother, with dreams of settling down, finally finds love online; her hopes for a romantic Valentine's Day take a terrifying turn when she's lured into a deadly trap, masterminded by a self-styled cult leader.

oxygenwest.us.title: Catfish Murders
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Killer Profile When an Arizona corrections officer vanishes after leaving for a hot date, investigators uncover blood in the desert, a digital phantom named Paige, and a predator lurking in plain sight.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E38 The Murder of Lorenzen Wright The murder of former NBA star and hometown hero Lorenzen Wright sends shockwaves through the city of Memphis, Tenn.; insiders speak out about new developments in the lengthy search for justice.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E39 The Murder of Lorenzen Wright The murder of former NBA star and hometown hero Lorenzen Wright sends shockwaves through the city of Memphis, Tenn.; insiders speak out about new developments in the lengthy search for justice.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S05 E15 Shannon's Story A college student goes missing in broad daylight from her off-campus job at a softball field; investigators receive a mysterious phone call that changes everything.

oxygenwest.us.title: Final Moments
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E09 House of Horror Bud and Melanie Billings lovingly adopt a houseful of special-needs kids; when a home robbery ends in Bud and Melanie's murders, police look for clues in the couple's home security camera system and find video that is both horrific and heartbreaking.

oxygenwest.us.title: Final Moments
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E05 A Mother's Search Ashley Young has an active online presence and loves posting on social media; when she suddenly stops communicating with loved ones, her mother launches a search to find out why; a gruesome discovery leads to a tragic answer.

oxygenwest.us.title: An Unexpected Killer
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E15 A Family Affair When a family that runs a beloved vet clinic is gunned down, police investigate disgruntled tenants, a pet owner with an ax to grind and an estranged son; the case stalls until detectives uncover a twisted plot by someone who seemed above suspicion.

oxygenwest.us.title: An Unexpected Killer
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Modern Family Murder While investigating the murder of a devoutly religious couple, police uncover dark family secrets, leading them to a shocking suspect.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Kimberly Warth When Las Vegas Police respond to a self-defense shooting, the case appears open and shut; following the discovery of bombshell video evidence that contradicts the shooter's initial story, a mother's desperation for him.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Killer Moms
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 Cynthia Cdebaca When a California man is found riddled with bullets in his own home, the investigation leads to an unconventional suspect close to the victim; a bizarre interrogation leaves a daughter heartbroken by the actions her mother took to protect her.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E20 Deliberate Evil Josh Mankiewicz returns to a case that took six years to report; a woman is found murdered after her friend hears her screaming on the phone, but the case sits cold until the mysterious death of her boyfriend's twin brother leads police to a suspect.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E09 Kill Switch Keith Morrison revisits a story where he says unusual would be putting it mildly; at first it appeared to be a drowning accident during a romantic sunset cruise; but soon Idaho investigators suspected something more sinister.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E10 Window of Opportunity A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother; Andrea Canning looks back at her emotional interview with Sarah, whose mom touched so many lives.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E25 The Betrayal of Sarah Stern Keith Morrison revisits a story that has haunted him for years; when detectives find a missing woman's car abandoned on a bridge, their investigation uncovers a tangled plot involving money, friendship and a deadly betrayal.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S03 E09 The Evil That Watches When three people are found dead on the same day in a Kentucky town, investigators know that it isn't a coincidence; years pass before an arrest; Keith Morrison reflects on the triple murder that shook a tight-knit community to its core.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S06 E07 Evil Walked Through the Door Two murders in Toronto ignite an investigation that spans four decades, but breakthroughs in investigative genetic genealogy help crack the case; Josh Mankiewicz revisits the mystery that took him to the coldest and most remote place he's ever been.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E26 The Dead of Night A mother of two vanishes in Monrovia, Calif.; as detectives investigate, the woman's loved ones reveal that she feared she was being stalked; for Josh Mankiewicz, cases like these are all too familiar, and that's a tragedy he just can't shake.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline: Unforgettable
oxygenwest.us.description: S02 E27 Deadly Valentine Nathan and Denise Leuthold build their family on faith, but suddenly one of them dies, and the other is under suspicion; it's a story that stays with Andrea Canning, both because of what happened and when it happened: Valentine's Day.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E40 Window of Opportunity - Part 1 A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother, who was killed when Sarah was 7.

oxygenwest.us.title: Dateline
oxygenwest.us.description: S07 E41 Window of Opportunity - Part 2 A bombshell more than a decade after the crime reignites the investigation into the death of Sarah Pagel's mother, who was killed when Sarah was 7.

oxygenwest.us.title: Murder and Justice: The Case of Martha Moxley
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E01 Mourning in Greenwich Laura Coates delves into the tragic 1975 murder of 15-year-old Martha Moxley to learn about a mother's quest for justice, what the crime scene and autopsy reveal about the killer, and how a break in the 23-year cold case ends in arrest.

oxygenwest.us.title: Murder and Justice: The Case of Martha Moxley
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E02 A Rollercoaster Trial A new look at Michael Skakel's 2002 trial to learn how prosecutors put him in jail, how defense lawyers got him out in 2013, and how a potential clue hints that two people might have killed Martha Moxley.

oxygenwest.us.title: Murder and Justice: The Case of Martha Moxley
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E03 Overlooked Theories Laura Coates delves into new theories about the 1975 murder of Martha Moxley, how Robert F. Kennedy Jr. investigated a potential eyewitness, and how Martha's mother copes without justice.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E05 Halloween Horror A teenage boy discovers a real-life horror scene in his home on Halloween morning; investigators must determine if the triple homicide is a random act of evil or a premeditated slaughter by someone close to the family.

oxygenwest.us.title: Homicide for the Holidays
oxygenwest.us.description: S04 E06 All Hallow's Evil After a single young mother fails to show up for work on Halloween, her family and friends suspect murder.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Behind Bars
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E05 Taylor Marks Serving a life sentence for the brutal stabbing of her own mother, Taylor Marks discusses the murder on camera for the first time ever; she claims she wasn't the mastermind behind the crime, but she knows who is.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped: Behind Bars
oxygenwest.us.description: S01 E06 Jamie Grachek Haunted by the events leading up to her conviction, Jamie Grachek is ready to tell her story for the first time after eight years behind bars and explains her version of what happened the night a violent home invasion left her ex-husband dead.

oxygenwest.us.title: Snapped
oxygenwest.us.description: S32 E25 Amber Burch When two men disappear in the quiet community of Clemmons, N.C., rumors swirl about a devil-worshipping couple and their house of horrors; an investigation leads police to discover there may be more than secrets buried in the backyard.

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

fxm.us.title: The Happening
fxm.us.description: An apocalyptic threat to humanity arrives out of the clear blue sky with a series of violent, inexplicable deaths spreading across the country. The cause of the terrifying phenomenon remains unknown, prompting science teacher Elliot Moore (Mark Wahlberg), his wife Alma (Zooey Deschanel) and his colleague Julian (John Leguizamo) to try to elude the invisible killer in Pennsylvania's farmland. Soon it becomes clear that no one is safe. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2008

fxm.us.title: The Fury
fxm.us.description: When a devious plot separates CIA agent Peter Sandza (Kirk Douglas) from his son, Robin (Andrew Stevens), the distraught father manages to see through the ruse. Taken because of his psychic abilities, Robin is being held by Ben Childress (John Cassavetes), who is studying people with supernatural powers in hopes of developing their talents as weapons. Soon Peter pairs up with Gillian (Amy Irving), a teen who has telekinesis, to find and rescue Robin. (Thriller, Horror) - 1978

fxm.us.title: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
fxm.us.description: Harriman Nelson (Walter Pidgeon) is the creator of a revolutionary nuclear submarine. After testing its capabilities in the Arctic Ocean, Nelson and the commanding officer (Robert Sterling) surface the vessel, only to discover the sky ablaze. Learning that the Van Allen radiation belt has caught fire, Nelson conceives a plan that could save the planet from destruction, but the U.N. shoots it down. Nelson is convinced it will work, but an onboard psychiatrist (Joan Fontaine) questions his sanity. (Science fiction) - 1961

fxm.us.title: Fantastic Voyage
fxm.us.description: The brilliant scientist Jan Benes develops a way to shrink humans, and other objects, for brief periods of time. Benes, who is working in communist Russia, is transported by the CIA to America, but is attacked en route. In order to save the scientist, who has developed a blood clot in his brain, a team of Americans in a nuclear submarine is shrunk and injected into Benes' body. They have a finite period of time to fix the clot and get out before the miniaturization wears off. (Science fiction) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: The Alligator People
fxm.us.description: Newly married nurse Joyce Webster (Beverly Garland) doesn't know what to think when her husband, Paul (Richard Crane), disappears during a train ride. She hires private investigators and eventually tracks him to an old bayou plantation, where the owner (Frieda Inescort) insists she's never heard of Paul. Joyce sticks around anyway and soon learns that local doctor Mark Sinclair (George Macready) has been using a life-altering alligator serum on the town's residents, and that Paul is among them. (Horror) - 1959

fxm.us.title: The Fly
fxm.us.description: When scientist Andre Delambre (Al Hedison) tests his matter transporter on himself, an errant housefly makes its way into the transportation chamber, and things go horribly wrong. As a result, Delambre's head and arm are now that of the insect. Slowly losing himself to the fly, Delambre turns to his wife, Helene (Patricia Owens), for help. But when tragedy strikes, Delambre's brother (Vincent Price) and Inspector Charas (Herbert Marshall) are forced to pick up the investigation. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1958

fxm.us.title: The Curse of the Fly
fxm.us.description: Scantily clad Patricia Stanley (Carole Gray) breaks out of a mental hospital and is picked up by passing motorist Martin Delambre (George Baker). The two do not reveal much about themselves to each other, but nevertheless decide to get married. At the Delambre family mansion, Patricia meets Martin's father, Henri (Brian Donlevy), an eccentric scientist. Snooping about the grounds, she discovers evidence of the family's strange experiments in teleportation and the grisly results thereof. (Horror, Science fiction, Mystery, Drama) - 1965

fxm.us.title: Arachnophobia
fxm.us.description: After a nature photographer (Mark L. Taylor) dies on assignment in Venezuela, a poisonous spider hitches a ride in his coffin to his hometown in rural California, where arachnophobe Dr. Ross Jennings (Jeff Daniels) has just moved in with his wife, Molly (Harley Jane Kozak), and young son. As town residents start turning up dead, Jennings begins to suspect spiders, and must face his fears as he and no-nonsense exterminator Delbert McClintock (John Goodman) fight to stop a deadly infestation. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1990

fxm.us.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
fxm.us.description: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. (Musical, Thriller, Crime drama) - 2007

fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive.
