5starmax.us.title: Ocean's 11
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
5starmax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
5starmax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
5starmax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

5starmax.us.title: Green Zone
5starmax.us.description: Chief Warrant Officer Roy Miller and his team of inspectors are on a mission in 2003 to find Iraq's reported stockpiles of weapons of mass destruction. Traveling from one dangerous site to another, Miller and his team fail to find any chemical agents or other weapons. Instead, they discover an elaborate cover-up in which the most-elusive weapon is truth. (Action, Thriller, War) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
5starmax.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Reframed: Next Gen Narratives - A Star Is Born
5starmax.us.description: Clover must leave her family behind to compete in an algorithm-based singing competition; pressure from the judges leads Clover to doubt herself, but her family's words give her the strength to perform. (Comedy, Drama, Community) - 2025-01-01

5starmax.us.title: Talk Black
5starmax.us.description: A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers. (Comedy) - 2021

5starmax.us.title: Skin Can Breathe
5starmax.us.description: A gay teen tries to adjust to a new life after moving from Cambodia to America with his mother. (Special, Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022-05-19

5starmax.us.title: Destroy All Monsters!
5starmax.us.description: Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens. (Science fiction) - 1968

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla, King of the Monsters!
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. newsman (Raymond Burr) in Tokyo recounts the story of a huge dinosaur roused from the sea by an atomic blast. (Science fiction) - 1956

5starmax.us.title: Christmas With the Kranks
5starmax.us.description: Finally alone for the holidays, Luther (Tim Allen) and Nora Krank (Jamie Lee Curtis) plan to eschew the Christmas traditions and take a cruise in the Caribbean instead. This doesn't sit well with their Christmas-obsessed neighbors Vic Frohmeyer (Dan Aykroyd) and Walt Scheel (M. Emmet Walsh), who are determined to win the annual "best decorated street" competition, and the Kranks soon find themselves social outcasts because of their lack of Christmas spirit. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2004

5starmax.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
5starmax.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Children, Science fiction) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: MacGruber
5starmax.us.description: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Head Office
5starmax.us.description: A U.S. senator's son (Judge Reinhold) gets a job at a conglomerate and falls for the chairman's (Eddie Albert) radical daughter. (Comedy) - 1986

5starmax.us.title: Due Date
5starmax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: The Wolfman
5starmax.us.description: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy. (Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Space Jam
5starmax.us.description: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated) - 1996

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. bbcamerica.us.title: The Return of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: When foreman Frank (James Karen) shows new employee Freddy (Thom Mathews) a secret military experiment in a supply warehouse, the two klutzes accidentally release a gas that reanimates corpses into flesh-eating zombies. As the epidemic spreads throughout Louisville, Ky., and the creatures satisfy their hunger in gory and outlandish ways, Frank and Freddy fight to survive with the help of their boss (Clu Gulager) and a mysterious mortician (Don Calfa). (Horror, Comedy) - 1985

bbcamerica.us.title: Night of the Living Dead
bbcamerica.us.description: For reasons unknown, the recently deceased are rising from the grave as flesh-hungry zombies. Fleeing from the undead horde, a small group of survivors, including Barbara (Patricia Tallman), Ben (Tony Todd) and Harry (Tom Towles), sequester themselves in a remote farmhouse. With the zombies outside the house multiplying, tensions flare, as the group argues over the best way to escape their increasingly dire situation before they are overrun completely. (Horror) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary
bbcamerica.us.description: Doctor Louis Creed (Dale Midkiff) moves his family to Maine, where he meets a friendly local named Jud Crandall (Fred Gwynne). After the Creeds' cat is accidentally killed, Crandall advises Louis to bury it in the ground near the old pet cemetery. The cat returns to life, its personality changed for the worse. When Louis' son, Gage (Miko Hughes), dies tragically, Louis decides to bury the boy's body in the same ground despite the warnings of Crandall and Louis' visions of a deceased patient. (Horror, Thriller) - 1989

bbcamerica.us.title: Pet Sematary Two
bbcamerica.us.description: When his mother, Renee (Darlanne Fluegel), dies, young Jeff Matthews (Edward Furlong) moves back to his hometown with his father, Chase (Anthony Edwards). Jeff grows friendly with Drew Gilbert (Jason McGuire) at school, who tells him about the Indian burial grounds that bring people and animals back to life, which led to the deaths of the Creed family who used to live in town. Desperately missing his mom, Jeff ignores warnings and buries her corpse, only to have her return in deadly zombie form. (Horror) - 1992

bbcamerica.us.title: Thinner
bbcamerica.us.description: Billy Halleck (Robert John Burke) is an obese lawyer who accidentally hits a Gypsy with his car after his wife distracts him. Given Halleck's influence in town and a general prejudice against Gypsies, he manages to brush the incident under the rug with some unethical legal help from his associates. However, the victim's father, Tadzu Lempke (Michael Constantine), places a curse on the heavyset man, and he starts to lose weight at an alarming rate, which is followed by other macabre events. (Horror) - 1996

bbcamerica.us.title: Misery
bbcamerica.us.description: After a serious car crash, novelist Paul Sheldon (James Caan) is rescued by former nurse Annie Wilkes (Kathy Bates), who claims to be his biggest fan. Annie brings him to her remote cabin to recover, where her obsession takes a dark turn when she discovers Sheldon is killing off her favorite character from his novels. As Sheldon devises plans for escape, Annie grows increasingly controlling, even violent, as she forces the author to shape his writing to suit her twisted fantasies. (Horror, Thriller) - 1990

bbcamerica.us.title: Christine
bbcamerica.us.description: Unpopular nerd Arnie Cunningham (Keith Gordon) buys a 1958 Plymouth Fury, which he names Christine. Arnie develops an unhealthy obsession with the car, to the alarm of his jock friend, Dennis Guilder (John Stockwell). After bully Buddy Repperton (William Ostrander) defaces Christine, the auto restores itself to perfect condition and begins killing off Buddy and his friends. Determined to stop the deaths, Dennis and Arnie's girlfriend, Leigh Cabot (Alexandra Paul), decide to destroy Christine. (Horror) - 1983

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hgtvwest.us.title: House Shock
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 A Reno She Never Saw Coming After living with her mom to save for their first home, a husband's out to plan a hidden renovation for his unsuspecting wife; now, Arielle and Steve are tasked to secretly transform a kitchen, living room and dining room without getting caught!

hgtvwest.us.title: 100 Day Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E08 Cow Country Cottage A family needs help building a cottage on their new lot in the middle of cow country; Mika and Brian look to transform their mud paddy into a field of dreams, but a surprise could completely derail this home's 100-day due date.

hgtvwest.us.title: 100 Day Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E10 Right In Our Own Backyard After nursing his father back to health, a man and his family are ready to move out of his childhood home and plant roots right in the backyard; Mika and Brian aim to give this family all the amenities they want in a home without going over budget.

hgtvwest.us.title: 100 Day Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E08 Nine Labs Under One Woof A couple and their nine dogs need of a fur-ever home with plenty of room for the whole litter; with seven of the dogs temporarily staying with her parents, Mika and Brian need to deliver a dog-friendly dream home fast.

hgtvwest.us.title: 100 Day Dream Home
hgtvwest.us.description: S04 E09 Neutral Glam After living in a historic house with a plethora of problems, a family looks to spread out in a new place with no maintenance issues; Mika and Brian are tasked to create their new home with ample storage and custom features for each family member.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S280 E05 Alice in FOMOland A married couple is desperate to escape their cramped condo in Fairfax, Va.; she's their agent with market-driven FOMO willing to spend big, but her cautious husband is fighting to protect his snowboarding lifestyle with a lower-priced home.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S272 E03 Dad's New Phase A single dad's still living with his ex, and it's time to find a place of his own in Louisville, Ky.; he wants to save money on a low-priced fixer, but his 17-year-old daughter stays with him part-time, and she has other thoughts.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S274 E14 Country Mouse vs. Uptown Girl For their next home in Philadelphia, a married couple looks for a place big enough to start a family; he aspires to be a stay-at-home dad and wants space in the suburbs, but she prefers to find a townhouse in the city.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E09 Can't Afford Another Mistake Married nurses need a bigger place for themselves and their five pets in New Jersey; they're wary of buying again after losing thousands on a previous home that fell through, but staying in their cramped row home is no longer an option.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters

network.us.description: The 118 race to emergencies at a commercial bakery and a bodybuilding competition; Bobby's annual performance reviews send Chimney to the firefighter academy, where he runs into a familiar face; Eddie's aunt gets involved in his personal life.

A fire breaks out in an accountant's office and a car crashes into a "living funeral"; Athena is shocked when a suspect dies in her custody minutes after she arrests him; Buck is attracted to a death doula; Maddie and Chimney are audited by the IRS.

The 118 race to rescue two roommates desperately trying to find a needle in a haystack at a landfill, and help a woman whose nightmare dream suddenly becomes a painful reality; Athena and Maddie team up to find a missing boy in a crowded mall.

A wedding proposal tragically intersects with a bank robbery; a bride is literally stuck on her way to the altar; Athena talks a victim through her grief; Buck finds a surprise visitor on his doorstep.

In honor of Bobby Nash's sacrifice, the 118 comes together to dedicate the firehouse in his memory; when a billionaire tech giant is involved in a life-or-death emergency, the team must race to his aid.
As a geostorm ravages Earth, Athena and Hen's space mission teeters on the edge; on the ground, the 118 battles chaos when technology goes rogue.
Athena and Hen face increasing dangers in space as friends both near and far try to get them home safely; the 118 continues to help victims of the geostorm and falling debris.

The 118 has a day from hell with a never-ending series of bizarre emergency calls; a man tapes himself to a freeway billboard; a restaurant manager destroys his own business; Eddie feels a spark with Christopher's former teacher.

A man gets pinned under a Humvee; a garage band rocks out too hard; Michael notices strange behavior at a nearby apartment; Hen's mother unexpectedly arrives and announces she is moving to Los Angeles.
The 118 are called to the tarmac when a flight attendant reaches her limit with her flight's passengers; Eddie worries Christopher will not accept him dating; Buck reconnects with an old flame.

Athena and the 118 race to save lives after a drunken driver causes a deadly pileup on the freeway; Maddie goes into labor; Hen and Karen are devastated as they prepare their foster daughter to be reunited with her birth mother.

cinevault.us.title: Hardwired
cinevault.us.description: After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much. (Action, Movie, Science fiction, Thriller) - 2009-11-03

cinevault.us.title: Half Past Dead
cinevault.us.description: Criminal mastermind Donny/49er One (Morris Chestnut) has set in motion a plan to infiltrate a high-tech prison in order to persuade a death row inmate to reveal the whereabouts of $200 million worth of gold. Undercover FBI agent Sascha (Steven Seagal) must stop him before it's too late. (Action, Movie, Thriller) - 2002-11-15

cinevault.us.title: Godzilla
cinevault.us.description: During a nuclear test, the French government inadvertently mutates a lizard nest; years later, a giant lizard makes its way to New York City. Dr. Niko Tatopoulos, an expert on the effects of radiation on animals, is sent by the U.S. government to study the beast. When the creature, dubbed "Godzilla" by news outlets, emerges, a massive battle with the military begins. To make matters worse, Niko discovers that Godzilla has laid a nest of 200 eggs, which are ready to hatch. (Action, Movie, Science fiction) - 1998-05-19

cinevault.us.title: Year One
cinevault.us.description: After Neanderthal hunter Zed (Jack Black) is exiled for eating forbidden fruit, he and his sardonic buddy Oh (Michael Cera) leave their village and begin an epic journey through history. The pals encounter biblical characters such as Cain (David Cross) and Abel, Abraham (Hank Azaria), and others, and wind up in Sodom. Along the way, Zed debunks commonly held beliefs and replaces them with his own delusions of grandeur. (Adventure, Comedy, Movie) - 2009-06-19

cinevault.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
cinevault.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Crime drama, Movie) - 2008-04-30

cinevault.us.title: Quicksilver
cinevault.us.description: A hotshot stock-exchange floor trader (Kevin Bacon) loses his shirt and becomes a bicycle messenger in a hilly city. (Action, Adventure, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1986-10-18

cinevault.us.title: Facing the Giants
cinevault.us.description: Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams. (Action, Drama, Movie) - 2006-09-29

cinevault.us.title: Crazy in Alabama
cinevault.us.description: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1999-09-09

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E03 Body Horror Sometimes disgusting, body horror films make audience members question their prejudices against physical difference, their attitudes about sex and gender, their fear of disease and contamination, and how much appearance determines destiny.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S02 E04 Witches The witch is a towering figure in the history of horror; the archetypical evil witch is everything mainstream religion tells believers a woman should not be -- and that unapologetic, very female power frightens men and fascinates women.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The Preppy Murder: Death in Central Park

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E07 Mom's Retreat Melissa and Lee's 3 boys need more room for sports, and Mom needs more peace and quiet! So Brian and Sarah turn the underused backyard into a sports court, a new lounge space, and a luxurious, 3-season Mom's retreat.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 Nana's Wonderland Janet's love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 The Bushland Treehouse Paul and Trent want to escape their busy lives to a 600-acre conservation property.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E01 Dream Island Home After years traveling through Europe, Iain and Alyson are ready to put down roots. Their search takes them to Inner Hebridean Island of Skye where they purchase a remote half acre plot, but building a traditional house is a challenge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Forest Treehouse Delaval and Veronica are restoring 450 acres for conservation and funding it by building a treehouse in Swanton Novers Wood. A Scottish firm constructs it in 7 sections to minimize damage to the woodland habitat on delivery.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Countryside Cabins Jamie Feilden's 60-acre farm doubles as a charity for urban youth. To fund it, he now plans two prefabricated elliptical cabins on a remote slope. They'll feature timber decks, open-plan living, and green roofs—though weather may delay the build.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Scotland's Island Cottage Builder Justin and wife Emma tackle an ambitious modular home build on Scotland's remote North Uist.

tastemadehome.us.title: Impossible Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 From Caravan to Dream Home Sarah and Adam swap caravan life for their dream home in rural Cornwall.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 A Tuscan Escape We meet Alex who is on the lookout for his forever home. Viviana is taking him through some of the most beautiful properties in Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 House Hunting For An Entrepreneur HQ Tyler is leaving Los Angeles to expand his business. He's visiting some of the most desirable properties in Silicon Valley, California. Will he find his dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 The Ultimate Home for Art Lovers George and Bill are looking to cut their commute and move to the city. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Palo Alto, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E10 Dreaming Big Estates We meet Michael and Kelly who are in search for a luxury home. Viviana is taking them through some the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito and Santa Barbara, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E12 The Ultimate Family Escape We meet John and Laura, a couple who are in search of a family escape luxury home. Viviana takes them through some of the most beautiful mega mansions in Montecito, California.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 The Educators' Dream Castle Michael and Lynne are looking for a new home for when they get married. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Pacific Palisades, California. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E02 An English Manor in the Golden State Kathy and her husband John are relocating from New York City to sunny California. They're looking for a house that's closer to their family. Will they find their dream home?

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Full Throttle Dream Homes We meet Steven. He is looking for a place to spend his weekends that will accommodate his love of Motor Sports. Viviana is taking him through some of the most desirable properties in this one-of-a-kind Motor Sports Country Club.

tastemadehome.us.title: Million Dollar Dream Home
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E11 Designing A New Life By The Beach Arica, a designer, and Sean, a contractor, are relocating from San Francisco. They're visiting some of the most desirable properties in Orange County, California. It's important for them to be closer to the beach and have space for their future dogs.

outlaw.us.title: Tension at Table Rock
outlaw.us.description: When locals are wrongfully led to believe that Wes Tancred murdered a gunslinger in cold blood, they exile the innocent man. Tancred sets off in search of a new start and arrives in the dusty hamlet of Table Rock -- only to find his reputation has preceded him. To avoid trouble, Tancred uses an assumed name. But, when Sheriff Fred Miller talks of trouble at the hands of a violent gang, Tancred agrees to be deputized, and struggles for his shot at redemption. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: The Sheepman
outlaw.us.description: Sheep farmer Jason Sweet (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small Western cattle town and promptly clashes with local tough guy Jumbo McCall (Mickey Shaughnessy). He also irks Stephen Bedford (Leslie Nielsen), a wealthy cattleman, with his advances toward Bedford's girlfriend, Dell Payton (Shirley MacLaine). With the entire town in an uproar over Sweet's behavior, Bedford arranges for Chocktaw Neal (Pernell Roberts), a seasoned gunslinger, to shoot him down. (Western, Comedy) - 1958

outlaw.us.title: The Last Challenge
outlaw.us.description: Hotshot gunfighter Lot McGuire intends to make a name for himself by out-duelling legendary bandit-turned-lawman Marshal Dan Blaine. Before any bullets fly, however, Lot and his intended enemy strike up an unlikely friendship, and Blaine tries to convince the youngster to call off the shootout. Unfortunately, Lot can't be talked out of his quest for glory, and so he guns down a few hostile locals, leaving Blaine no choice but to finally accept the offer for a showdown. (Western) - 1967

outlaw.us.title: Catlow
outlaw.us.description: A friendly marshal (Richard Crenna) and a hired gun (Leonard Nimoy) hunt a post-Civil War drifter (Yul Brynner) out to rob $2 million in federal gold. (Western) - 1971

outlaw.us.title: The Rounders
outlaw.us.description: Two cowboys (Glenn Ford, Henry Fonda) get drunk, cavort with women and take bets on a bucking stallion that likes corn mash. - 1965

outlaw.us.title: The Fastest Gun Alive
outlaw.us.description: The son of a notorious gunslinger attempts to bury his reputation and avoid his father's legacy in a small frontier town. - 1956

outlaw.us.title: Montana Belle
outlaw.us.description: Singing outlaw Belle Starr quits the Dalton gang and tricks a saloon keeper. - 1952

outlaw.us.title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
outlaw.us.description: Robert Ford tries to join the Missouri outlaw gang led by his longtime hero, the legendary Jesse James. However, he soon grows resentful of the bandit, ultimately hatching a plan to kill him and take his place. - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
outtvproud.us.description: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down. (Science fiction, Action, Thriller) - 1993

outtvproud.us.title: Bug
outtvproud.us.description: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair. (Drama, Thriller, Horror) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Backtrack
outtvproud.us.description: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be. (Thriller, Comedy) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: Wisegirls
outtvproud.us.description: Low on money and fresh out of hope, aspiring doctor Meg Kennedy is forced to return home to Staten Island, N.Y., where she finds work as a waitress at Santalino's, a boisterous Italian restaurant. Soon, Meg befriends coworkers Raychel and Kate and begins a new life. But after Meg discovers that Santalino's is a mob front, she finds herself deep in danger, and is recruited by the police to spy on her criminally connected boss. (Crime drama) - 2002

outtvproud.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
outtvproud.us.description: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park. (Horror, Dark comedy) - 1986

outtvproud.us.title: Heretic
outtvproud.us.description: A diabolical Mr. Reed ensnares two young missionaries in a terrifying game of cat and mouse when they knock on the wrong door and are forced to prove their faith. (Thriller, Horror) - 2024

outtvproud.us.title: All the Boys Love Mandy Lane
outtvproud.us.description: Beautiful Mandy Lane (Amber Heard) isn't a party girl but, when classmate Chloe (Whitney Able) invites the Texas high school student to a bash in the countryside, she reluctantly accepts. After hitching a ride with a vaguely scary older man (Anson Mount), the teens arrive at their destination. Partying ensues, and Mandy's close pal, Emmet (Michael Welch), keeps a watchful eye on the young males making a play for Mandy. Then two of the students are murdered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2006

outtvproud.us.title: Sharknado
outtvproud.us.description: A monstrous storm devastates Los Angeles, leaving the streets flooded and infested with sharks. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy) - 2013

outtvproud.us.title: Sharknado 2: The Second One
outtvproud.us.description: A freak weather system turns its deadly fury on New York City, unleashing a Sharknado on the population and its most cherished, iconic sites - and only Fin and April can save the Big Apple. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction, Adventure, Comedy) - 2014

outtvproud.us.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
outtvproud.us.description: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1989

oxygentruecrime.us.title: Prosecuting Evil With Kelly Siegler - Triangle of Guilt
oxygentruecrime.us.description: A young woman vanishes after a night out in Dallas, leading investigators to the home of an aspiring rapper in a twisted love triangle; following an international manhunt, prosecutors must prove who killed her with no weapon or cause of death. (Law, Crime) - 2026-10-24

oxygentruecrime.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - Evil Was Waiting
oxygentruecrime.us.description: Vince Goslyn's military career was thriving, and he had built a beautiful family; one night, the father of five was gunned down. (Crime, Docudrama) - 2020-07-03

oxygentruecrime.us.title: Dateline: Secrets Uncovered - Evil Paid a Visit

He says that, actually, she tried to seduce the victim to gather information about a mob chieftain. (Crime drama, Mystery, Thriller) - 2005

shadesofblack.us.title: Caught in the Crossfire
shadesofblack.us.description: Two detectives (Chris Klein, Richard T. Jones) are targeted by gangsters and crooked cops as they investigate an important case. (Crime drama) - 2010

shadesofblack.us.title: Soul Men
shadesofblack.us.description: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. (Comedy) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Mad Money
shadesofblack.us.description: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction. (Comedy) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: Bad Ass 2 : Bad Asses
shadesofblack.us.description: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with his agoraphobic buddy Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to clean up Los Angeles' crime-infested streets. (Action, Comedy) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Next Day Air
shadesofblack.us.description: Delivery man Leo Jackson (Donald Faison) is definitely on the wrong road to success. He still lives at home, he and his girlfriend just broke up, and he has multiple complaints stacked against him at work. Fortunately, Leo has plenty of marijuana to keep his mind off his troubles. But when he accidentally delivers a box of cocaine to the wrong address, Leo finds himself in the middle of a bad deal that may just cost him his life. (Comedy drama, Crime drama, Action) - 2009

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Mix
shadesofblack.us.description: Mobster Frank (Chazz Palminteri) hires hip DJ Darrell (Usher) to man the turntables at a party for his gorgeous daughter, Dolly (Emmanuelle Chriqui). At the event, some crooks pull guns on the gangster, and Darrell steps in to save his life. Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. Their romance is interrupted when Frank gets involved in a mob war and drags Darrell along with him. (Comedy drama) - 2005

waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- UK Part 2 Andy visits the land of Scotland; he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette.

The Lone Wolf This week we celebrate the 40th Anniversary of Lone Wolf stands and the man that started it all, the Lone Wolf himself Andrae D'Acquisto. As we take a look back at Andrae's career, how it all started and where it's heading after 4 decades.

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
truehistory.us.description: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
truehistory.us.description: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
truehistory.us.description: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Go: A Game of Near-Infinite Complexity
truehistory.us.description: Go is an intricate strategy game that outshines chess in East Asia because of its challenging nature and unique setup. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Great Board Games of the Ancient World - Sowing Seeds: Africa's Mancala Family
truehistory.us.description: Mancala is a family of traditional African games dating back over 7,000 years. Awari and Bao are two members that fall on opposite ends of the spectrum of difficulty. (History) - 2022-07-15

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Why Egypt Needed Hieroglyphs
truehistory.us.description: Understanding why Ancient Egypt has to invent some form of writing; central to this introduction is a study of the Narmer Palette; its writing sets standards and conventions that would be followed for 3,000 years. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - The Ancient Egyptian Alphabet
truehistory.us.description: Learning the hieroglyphic alphabet; how to write and position each hieroglyph, including a stylized hand, a horned viper and two hieroglyphs for which English does not have a letter; transcribing one's name from English to ancient Egyptian. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - How a Language Becomes Lost
truehistory.us.description: Wondering how it is possible for a language used by the world's greatest civilization to become lost; charting the rise and fall of Ancient Egypt's kingdoms; investigating the ways Christianity replaces hieroglyphs with Greek letters. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Decoding the Secrets of Egyptian Hieroglyphs - Napoleon in Egypt
truehistory.us.description: Exploring how hieroglyphs and the ability to read them are rediscovered during Napoleon's invasion of Egypt; considering the birth of Egyptology; the role of ushabtis, statues of servants that are buried with prominent Egyptians. (World history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: World Heritage Sites: Exploring the World's Greatest Places - Paleolithic Cave Art of Spain and France

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
tastemadetravel.us.description: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-31

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-04-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats
tastemadetravel.us.description: Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of Their Own
tastemadetravel.us.description: Amazonas softball team; sweet potato and meat salpicon; pepita, egg and chaya tamales; roasted tomato and habanero salsa. (Cooking) - 2023-11-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tucson: Gateway to Sonora
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour. (Cooking) - 2024-01-25

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Jalisco Classics
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Guadalajara, Pati learns the secrets to menudo and birria. In her kitchen, Pati perfects her own recipes for a few Jalisco favorites: menudo, tepache, and jericalla. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hermosillo Food Crawl
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati spends a day in Sonora's capital, Hermosillo, visiting some of the city's best culinary destinations. From gigantic burritos at Doña Guille to Sonoran hot dogs, Pati experiences all Hermosillo's food scene has to offer. (Cooking) - 2024-01-25

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Blessing and The Benefit
tastemadetravel.us.description: On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati. (Cooking) - 2024-02-01

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Food Meets Art
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake. (Cooking) - 2024-02-29

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Getting to the Roots
tastemadetravel.us.description: The chefs and owners of Xokol restaurant in Guadalajara reconnect with their roots; chef Marin creates a drink and dessert inspired by his grandmother; chef Francisco Migoya makes a dessert. (Cooking) - 2021-10-27

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Traditional Greek Cuisine
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Greece, to the island of Skopelos, starting on the mainland in Thessaloniki. Inspired by meze plates and traditional island cuisine he cooks up a smoky aubergine flatbread and a lemony chargrilled chicken with tzatziki and rice. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Making Couscous in Tunisia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie explores Tunisia to meet traditional couscous makers, eat delicious street food, and get invited to cook with local chefs on a beach. Inspired by everything he sees, Jamie cooks crispy prawn parcels and a chicken and merguez sausage stew. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Inspirational Spanish Tapas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie's soaking up inspiration in Spain with tapas, flavor-charged rice dishes, and spectacular seafood. He cooks a stunning pork chop with peppers and aioli and a surf and turf skewer of prawns, mushrooms, and local ham. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks the Mediterranean - Stunning Seafood of Marseille
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads to Marseille in the south of France. Inspired by their stunning seafood, the traditional flavors of Provence, and the multicultural dishes being served up there, he cooks up a steak with a twist and a sublime courgette and olive tart. (Cooking)

thestandupchannel.us.description: Tahir Moore brings high-energy, no-filter comedy in a wild ride through the zombie apocalypse, fancy toilets, naps, and aging; self-roasting, brutally honest, and always hilarious-this is stand-up with zero chill, big laughs, and all heart.

thestandupchannel.us.description: Kevin Smith is anything but quiet in this new comedy special that was recorded an hour before his heart attack in February; before he nearly died backstage, onstage he discusses his marriage, his kid and his work (or lack thereof).

classica.us.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Magdalena Kožená und der Tenor Andrew Staples schließen sich Sir Simon Rattle an, um den Zyklus "Das Lied von der Erde" von Gustav Mahler zu Gehör zu bringen. Das Konzert fand am 9. Mai 2021 im Barbican Centre in London statt. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-12-06

classica.us.title: Martha Argerich - Eine Geburtstagsfeier - II
classica.us.description: Anlässlich ihres 80. Geburtstags erkundet die argentinische Pianistin Martha Argerich im Château de Chantilly das Repertoire der Kammermusik. Die "Grande Dame" des Klaviers wird von verschiedenen renommierten Künstlern begleitet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-24

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
classica.us.description: Francesco Attesti gilt als einer der besten Interpreten des romantischen Repertoires. Zusammen mit dem Dirigenten Paolo Belloli und dem OIDA-Orchester spielt er die Klavierkonzerte Nr. 14 und 23, KV 449 und KV 488 von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2020-12-03

classica.us.title: Beethoven, Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37
classica.us.description: Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Klavierkonzert Nr. 3 c-Moll op. 37. Yefim Bronfman (Klavier), Staatskapelle Dresden, Leitung: Christian Thielemann. Aufgenommen in der Semperoper Dresden. Beethovens Ausdrucksmittel für Sturm und Drang war c-Moll: In dieser Tonart schrieb er seine dramatischsten und heroischsten Werke, darunter die 5. Symphonie und die Klaviersonate op. 13, seine berühmte "Pathétique". (Special, Entertainment, Music, Classical) - 2017-03-27

classica.us.title: Werke für Cello und Klavier: Debussy, Brahms u.a
classica.us.description: Silvia Chiesa und Maurizio Baglini präsentieren ein Konzert im Rahmen des Amiata Piano Festivals 2023, das im Forum Fondazione Bertarelli in Poggi del Sasso in Italien gegeben wurde. Es wurden Stücke von Claude Debussy und Johannes Brahms gespielt. (Special, Music, Event) - 2025-01-06

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Puccini - Madama Butterfly
classica.us.description: Beatrice Venezi führt an der Oper von Metz durch Giacomo Puccinis tragische Oper "Madama Butterfly". Die 1904 uraufgeführte Oper dreht sich um die junge japanische Geisha Butterfly, die auf die Rückkehr ihres amerikanischen Geliebten wartet. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-09-26

classica.us.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda (1975) spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. Er ist besonders für seine Interpretationen einiger kürzlich entdeckter Werke von Mendelssohn und seine 9-teilige CD-Serie über Klavierwerke des Komponisten bekannt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-12-15

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: Mozart - Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626
classica.us.description: Daniel Harding dirigiert das Orchester und den Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino sowie vier Gesangssolisten in einer prächtigen Aufführung von Wolfgang Amadeus Mozarts Requiem in d-Moll, K. 626. Die Solisten sind die Sopranistin Christiane Karg, die Mezzosopranistin Sara Mingardo, der Tenor Matthew Swensen und der Bass Gianluca Buratto. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2024-11-03

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
classica.us.description: Philippe Jordan dirigiert das Orchester de l'Opéra national de Paris in Beethovens Symphonie Nr. 8. Gespielt wird die Symphonie in F-Dur Op. 93, welche in den Jahren 1812 und 1813 geschrieben wurde und im Jahr 1814 ihre Erstaufführung feierte. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2024-04-02

classica.us.title: Streichquartett Nr. 7 & 13 und Große Fuge
classica.us.description: Das Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène hat anlässlich des 250. Geburtstages von Ludwig van Beethoven alle 16 Streichquartette des Komponisten aufgenommen. In dieser Sendung spielt Quatuor Ébène Beethovens Streichquartett Nr. 7 in F-Dur, Op. 133. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-03

classica.us.title: Bach - Sonate Nr. 6 BWV 1019
classica.us.description: Der Pianist Enrico Pace und der Violinist Frank Peter Zimmermann spielen Bachs sechste Sonate. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2014-09-12

classica.us.title: The Pianists Keys

classica.us.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
classica.us.description: Franz Welser-Möst dirigiert das Cleveland Orchestra und den Chor in einem Konzert mit Werken von Richard Strauss, Metamorphosen, und Mozarts Requiem. Die Solisten sind Siobhan Stagg, Avery Amereau, Ben Bliss und Anthony Robin Schneider. Aufgenommen wurde dies in der Severance Hall, Cleveland im März 2023. (Special, Music) - 2023-01-01

classica.us.title: Modena - Stadt von Belcanto
classica.us.description: Die Studenten von Raina Kabaivanska beschäftigen sich mit dem Diptychon von Menotti in Modena. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical) - 2018-03-27

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klavierkonzert Nr. 5, op. 73

classica.us.title: Mahler - 2. Sinfonie

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Lots of Muddy Puddles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment)

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Mandy Mouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Recorders
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Miss Rabbit's Relaxation Class
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Miss Rabbit persuades Mummy Pig to go to her relaxation class, but relaxing proves more difficult than expected. However, thanks to Daddy Pig's bouncy castle, they all have fun in the end. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Parking Ticket
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Big Ben & Holly
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When a spell accidentally goes wrong, Ben and Holly grow to human size! Now they able to play with Lucy and her friends and want to stay big forever. (Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Animated, Children) - 2013

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Daisy & Poppy go Bananas
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas. (Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Animated, Children) - 2013

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Mr Elf takes a Holiday
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased, but Mrs Elf and Ben are overjoyed! Meanwhile, Nanny takes over the food deliveries. (Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Animated, Children) - 2013

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom - Honey Bees
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Ben and Holly visit the bee hive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the bee keeper and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey. (Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Animated, Children) - 2013

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Gabby's Dollhouse - Googly Eyes
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a trouble-making surprise; luckily, MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble. (Fantasy, Children) - 2023

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Funny Music
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Spooky Clubhouse
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A curious, naive, yet friendly little pig navigates through her life with her friends and family by her side. Guided by her loving mother and brash father, Peppa is stuck almost every day. Her little siblings, however, look up to Peppa lovingly. (Adventure, Animated, Children)

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Marbles
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Rebecca and Richard Rabbit are playing a marble run game at Peppa's house. But when Daddy Pig joins in and improvises tunnels and bridges, the marble rolls out of the bedroom, causing chaos and nearly knocking Goldie out of her bowl. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Metal Detector
nickjrtoo.uk.description: When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - World Book Day
nickjrtoo.uk.description: For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Children's Festival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy all go on a lovely trip to the children's festival. There is lots to see and do, including singing, making crafts and listening to stories. (Adventure, Animated, Children)

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Peppa Pig Special: Muddy Festival
nickjrtoo.uk.description: Day two at the festival and it has rained all night. The festival is very muddy and Peppa is thrilled. Luckily, it rains every year and Miss Rabbit is prepared with lots of muddy activities. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment)

nickjrtoo.uk.title: Peppa Pig - Series 99 : Strawberries
nickjrtoo.uk.description: A curious, naive, yet friendly little pig navigates through her life with her friends and family by her side. Guided by her loving mother and brash father, Peppa is stuck almost every day. Her little siblings, however, look up to Peppa lovingly. (Adventure, Animated, Children, Entertainment) - 2019
