10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E9 Animal Island Blaze and Stripes discover Animal Island - where everyone is a talking monster truck animal. But a greedy lizard puts the island in peril, so Blaze and Stripes must try to save their new friends.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E21 Pups Save A Cuckoo Clock / Pups Save MS. Marjorie's House Chickaletta is stuck inside Jake's family cuckoo clock and it's sliding down the moutnainside! / Mysterious holes are appearing all over Ms. Marjorie's yard, and now she and Maynard have gotten stuck in them!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E22 Pups Rescue Thanksgiving / Pups Save A Windy Bay An inflatable turkey for Adventure Bay's Thanksgiving feast flies away. Zuma competes in Adventure Bay's windsurfing race with Mayor Goodway, Katie, Daring Danny X, and Mayor Humdinger.

10shakeperth.au.title: Dora
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 Troll Jelly / Catch That Kitty Dora and Boots help the Grumples make troll jelly before the Grumpy Old Troll's snack time. / Dora and Boots have to recover El Gatito Magico so all the friends stop acting like a cat.

10shakeperth.au.title: Baby Shark's Big Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E12 Blizz's Big Bite / Friend Of A Friend Baby and William help Blizzard Wizard try new foods around Carnivore Cove. / Bait gets jealous of Switch's new friend.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E10 Toucan Do It! Blaze, Starla and Darington want to play jungle ball. But when their teammate Tooks the Toucan gets launched from the stadium, it's up to the friends to get her back in the game.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E11 Falcon Quest High above Animal Island, a remarkable race is about to begin. Challenged by a tough-talking falcon, Blaze takes off on a journey to earn his place with the fast fliers in the sky above Animal Island.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E24 Pups Save A Lonesome Walrus/pups Save The Hummy Gummies Wally the Walrus searches Adventure Bay for Cap'n Turbot & turns the town upside-down in the process. // Helga Humdinger's Hummy Gummy treats cause Mayor Humdinger to get jealous and steal them all.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S8 E25 Rubble & Wild A Yarn Ball/ Skye & Rory Flip It/ Marshal,l Leo & Ferris Wheel/ Everest & The Mnt Goat Rubble & Wild rescue animals from a giant ball of yarn/ Skye & Rory rescue a painter from a scaffold/ Marshall & Leo rescue animals on a Ferris Wheel/ Everest & Shade rescue a baby mountain goat.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tim Rex in Space
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E5 Rumblefest Eve / Rumblefest / Hat The Rumblefest tree for Rumblefest eve is missing, Tim must save the day! / Tim and Kai worry they've ruined Rumblefest. / Grandma gives Tim a hat she made, unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble & Crew
10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E1 The Crew Builds A Fancy Drive-Thru Restaurant / The Crew Builds A Castle Show When truckie Camila needs a bite to eat, the pups and Cafe Carl whip up a fancy roadside stop. / Park Ranger Rose's goat Rosie goes missing before showtime, and the pups race to find her.

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E18 Sir Nonny The Nice Nonny is on a quest to become a real knight! He has a shield. He has a suit of armour. But does he have what it takes to win a knightly game of mini-golf?

10shakeperth.au.title: Bubble Guppies
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E15 Bubble Duckies! Welcome to the Wings Over Bubbletucky Air Show! Today the Bubble Guppies are watching a whole bunch of birds take flight!

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E5 The Dollhouse Dress Up Chest Gabby and Pandy go on a dress-up adventure in the dollhouse, wearing different costumes to help the Gabby Cats get out of some sticky situations.

10shakeperth.au.title: Mr. Crocodile
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E11 Cluc Croc / One Tree Home Mr. Crocodile joins gymnastics club because Daisy loves it. // Mr. Crocodile and Daisy help Gigi and Roland find separate homes when they don't want to share a tree anymore.

10shakeperth.au.title: Garden Academy
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E12 Triangle & Yellow Gardener Tim shares a special lesson with Margarita and Col. They learn about triangles objects and the colour yellow through known objects.

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E7 Deep Sea Grand Prix For the first time ever, Blaze and AJ are racing under the ocean! Blaze transforms into a submarine and speeds through sunken ships and coral reefs to reach the giant sand castle at the finish line!

10shakeperth.au.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E8 Recycling Power! Axle City is visited by a littering raccoon, it's up to Blaze to save the day as a Super Recycling Truck! He cleans up the town & rescues his friends, just in time for a final showdown!

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E23 Pups Save A Frozen Camp Out / Pups Save The Fizzy Pickles Cap'n Turbot brings the Porters to Sunny Slope Island for a camp-out, but the next day, snow falls on to the island. An over-pressurized pickle jar pops and knocks Cap'n Turbot's.

10shakeperth.au.title: Paw Patrol
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E24 Pups Save A Pluck-O-Matic / Pups Save A Mascot Rocky must shut down the farm's out-of-control corn harvester machine. The Adventure Bay cheer team, led by Mayor Goodway and Francois, is joined by the newcomer, Danny, but he is taken away by eagles.

10shakeperth.au.title: Super Duper Bunny League
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E2 Auntie Freeze! / Goin' Camping! The team fights an ice-ray wielding villain/ Annabelle takes the team camping.

10shakeperth.au.title: Kamp Koral: SpongeBob's Under Years
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E5 The Treasure Of Kamp Koral/Camper Gary SpongeBob and Patrick find buried treasure at camp, but Mr. Krabs becomes desperate to get his claws on it. // SpongeBob disguises Gary as a new camper to keep him safe from Mrs. Puff.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Patrick Star Show
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E12 At Home, On The Lam / Pick Patrick's Path Bunny must punish Patrick for chocolate-flavoured crimes. // The Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Smurfs
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E26 A Smurfy Christmas / An Unsmurfy Friendship Christmas is coming and Jokey decides to mix up the Smurfs' letter to Santa. // When he's sidelined from the Smurfball tournament, Grouchy heads to the forest and befriends Bigmouth.

10shakeperth.au.title: The Loud House
10shakeperth.au.description: S6 E13 Crashed Course/puns And Buns The Loud siblings intervene when they think Lori is failing out of Fairway U. // Benny struggles to rein in Luan and her practical jokes when she becomes his coworker at the Burpin' Burger.

10shakeperth.au.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 Zuko Alone Travelling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E23 Sandy's Nutmare / Bulletin Board Sandy creates the latest acorn-based food sensation, but her tree pays the price. SpongeBob erects a community bulletin board in the Krusty Krab, but anonymous reviews posted on it lead to trouble.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S9 E24 Food Con Castaways / Snail Mail The gang heads to a food convention, but things go awry when they become stranded in the woods. SpongeBob lies to his pen pal, but when his friend comes to visit, he must keep the ruse going!

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E1 The Algae's Always Greener/ Spongeguard On Duty Plankton has an invention that allows him to switch lives with Mr. Krabs. // When Larry the Lobster is short one man for lifeguard duty, SpongeBob Volunteers.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S3 E2 Club Spongebob/ My Pretty Seahorse SpongeBob and Patrick build a small clubhouse in a tree - when Squidward wants to join their club, he literally doesn't fit in. // SpongeBob finds a stray sea horse and adopts it.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S14 E6 Tango Tangle / Necro-Nom-Nom-Nom-I-Con Plankton and Karen take dance lessons and quickly become the top of the class. // Equipped with a magical spell book, SpongeBob cooks up chaos in the Krusty Krab kitchen.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S14 E7 Pl-1413 / In The Mood To Feud Plankton travels two thousand years into the future and finds a few unfamiliar faces. // SpongeBob, Patrick, and Sandy find themselves in the middle of a long-standing feud.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E12 Sterling And Carly Aquilino Xcvi On Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Carly Aquilino address some grandparent damage in GRANDKID WOUNDS, have their good vibes killed by MOOD DEFLATORS and have some Southern fun with REDNECK RELAXATION.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E13 Sterling And Karrueche Tran Lxv On Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Karrueche Tran risk getting some sleep in EXPOSED NAPS, find uses besides hockey for their UTILI-STICKS, and take a beating from above with CEILING ASSAULTS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S42 E15 Sterling and Carly Aquilino XCVII On Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Carly Aquilino hit their heads with NO HEIGHT AWARENESS, and get their multitasking degrees at MULTITASK UNIVERSITY.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ink Master
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E1 Hometown Throwdown 15 global tattoo artists fight to represent their hometowns, but must first earn a spot to compete for $250k and the title of Ink Master.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ink Master
10shakeperth.au.description: S17 E2 Back To The Drawing Board The fight for a shop continues as artists tattoo hometown animals. For some, it's back to the drawing board. The battle is just beginning.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S38 E33 Jenni \ On an all new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Nina Agdal welcome Jersey Shore's Jenni JWOWW Farley to hit the kitchen in COOKING WITH KIDS and shoot down advances in CREATIVE CURVES.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S38 E34 Sterling And Lolo Wood Xxix In an all new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob and Steelo welcome Lolo Wood to check out some IGUANA DRAMA and brace themselves for KID COLLISIONS.

10shakeperth.au.title: Ridiculousness
10shakeperth.au.description: S40 E2 Sterling and Lolo Wood XXXVI On this episode of Ridiculousness Rob, Steelo, and Lolo Wood learn about high speed presents with DRIVE-BY GIFTS, run up against a wall with RUN-BLOCKS and take on some mom insults with CRITICAL MOMS.

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Befana
abcentertains.au.description: Marinette's grandmother gets akumatized. Now Befana, she wants to get revenge on Marinette who would rather spend time with her friends than with her. Will Ladybug dare to fight her own grandmother? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Malory Towers - The Last Letter
abcentertains.au.description: Jo's poison pen letters spiral out of control when Felicity is wrongly accused of writing them. Gwen isn't going to let the perpetrator get off lightly and starts to hunt down the author. Can Jo do the right thing and own up? (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Odd Squad - Put Me in Coach
abcentertains.au.description: When Ms O accidentally assigns Olympia and Otis and a rival duo to the same coveted case she sends them all to Coach O, who sets up a competition between the teams to resolve who gets the case. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: We Bare Bears - Vacation
abcentertains.au.description: Nom Nom is ordered by his doctor to take a vacation. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Little Lunch - The Thing In The Sand
abcentertains.au.description: Melanie thinks she discovers a possum's head in the sand pit, and refuses to believe that it's actually Rory's craft project made out of a pine-cone and toilet paper.

abcentertains.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire - Sharpedo Attack!
abcentertains.au.description: When a school of Sharpedo attacks, Ash and friends are stranded on an uncharted island! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Transformers: Earthspark - A Stygi Situation
abcentertains.au.description: Jawbreaker finally gains an alt-mode, but instead of changing into it, the alt-mode changes him. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Adventure Time - Daddy's Little Monster
abcentertains.au.description: Finn and Jake return to the Nightosphere to rescue Marceline and get to the bottom of what's making her act so crazy. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Beast Boys St. Patrick's Day Luck and It's Bad
abcentertains.au.description: The Titans must travel to the end of the rainbow. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Teen Titans Go! - Oh Yeah!
abcentertains.au.description: Cyborg teaches the other Titans about \. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: The Amazing World of Gumball - The Cycle
abcentertains.au.description: Discovering that Mr Wilson has been picking on their Dad for most of his life, the kids try to work Dad through it. When their efforts fail, they realize that getting back at Mr Wilson is the only way to break the cycle. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Happy Magic Forest - Magic Mess
abcentertains.au.description: The heroes quest to save the forest from a magical mess after Blossom decides she'd rather be picnicking than recycling. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Submarine Jim - The Fork
abcentertains.au.description: Because he's missing a fork to serve his lavish dinner, Jim starts working for Don Limpetone, the leader of the limpets' gang. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Total Dramarama - Inglorious Toddlers
abcentertains.au.description: Owen fears he's about to lose his BFF Noah to a gifted military school. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir - Rocketear
abcentertains.au.description: As Guardian of the Miraculous, Ladybug must make difficult decisions which affect the people around her. But not everyone is ready to live in permanent hiding like her. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Ninjago - Spellbound
abcentertains.au.description: Nya has proof of Chen's plan but he entices the contestants to hunt her down with promises to advance the winner, forcing the Ninja in a race to get to her first. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Learn A Word - Love
abcentertains.au.description: Learn to spell and write the word Love. This series shows an easy way to learn the basic words used in English, based on the Australian National Curriculum. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Alphablocks - An Apple a Day
abcentertains.au.description: In a play hospital doctors fail to cure Alphablock A with a bandage from their BAG. A RAM is no use. A HAT makes A too hot. A FAN makes her too cold. A NAP helps. An apple is best!

abcentertains.au.title: Colourblocks - Purple
abcentertains.au.description: Imaginative Purple arrives in Colourland. Learn about the colour purple with the Colourblocks. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Numberblocks - Double Doors, Double Locked
abcentertains.au.description: When Numberblocks One to Five take on Fifteen's challenge to unlock every door they need help from the Super Special Secret Step Squad. (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures - Along Came a Space Spider!
abcentertains.au.description: Three baby Space Spiders swing around Reader Valley leaving it all webbed up! (Kids & Family)

abcentertains.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know? - How Is It Made? Carrots
abcentertains.au.description: Maddie visits a farm to find out how carrots grow from tiny seeds into big carrots we can eat.

abcentertains.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior - Log Pot Party
abcentertains.au.description: Millie, Harper and Xavier, explore a garden to look for plants that survive and thrive in unusual places. They decide to turn dead logs and branches into mini gardens. It's a Log Pot Party! (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: Horrible Histories - Wily Winston Churchill
abcentertains.au.description: We follow Churchill from a young soldier in India during the time of Queen Victoria, through the First World War to victory in WWII and finally to his retirement in the Swinging Sixties. (Comedy)

abcentertains.au.title: Past to Present - Ancient Greece
abcentertains.au.description: Discover the amazing world of ancient Greece, including trend-setting temples, the ancient Olympics and the famous story of Demeter and Persephone.

abcentertains.au.title: The Ancient World Greece - Citizenship
abcentertains.au.description: Citizenship was an important concept that the ancient Greeks imparted to the modern-day Western world. It dictated both social privilege and expectations about how you would live your life as a member of a city-state. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: BTN
abcentertains.au.description: BTN is a high-energy, fun way for Upper Primary and Secondary students to learn about current issues and events in their world. Each program is built around major news stories of the week.

abcentertains.au.title: Stories of Modern Australia - Federation of Australian Colonies
abcentertains.au.description: Unpack the fascinating story of Federation, and how the six separate colonies united to form a nation. (Special Interest)

abcentertains.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
abcentertains.au.description: Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

abcmelbourne.au.title: News Breakfast ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E216 Thursday 29 October 2026 News Breakfast gives you the morning advantage. James Glenday and Emma Rebellato bring you the latest news, sport with Catherine Murphy and weather with Nate Byrne. Don't just start your day informed, start your day in front.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News Mornings ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E216 Thursday 29 October 2026 Stay in the know with what's going on this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Kathryn Robinson.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Hard Quiz
abcmelbourne.au.description: S11 E23 Tom Gleeson puts four more self-proclaimed experts through the Big Brass wringer. Tonight's topics are Iron Maiden, Apocalypse Now, Stranger Things, and Microsoft PowerPoint!

abcmelbourne.au.title: Class Clowns
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E5 Episode 5 In English class our teams must perform original poems based on real high school experiences. Next it's Sports Day, where our comedians must compete in a tug-of-war battle against various teams of kids.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Crime Night!
abcmelbourne.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Julia Zemiro, David Bartlett, Danielle Reynald, Alexei Toliopoulos, Alex Ward and guest Rachael Brown explore our obsession with 'Crime-tainment' and why we find real-life crime so entertaining.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Small Prophets
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E5 Strange things are happening in Marvin Gardens and they're starting to attract unwanted attention. It's time for Kacey and Michael to exhume the prophets from their pile of manure.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News At Noon ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E216 Thursday 29 October 2026 The leading news at lunchtime. Ros Childs brings you the day's top stories and the latest news as it unfolds, with reporters in the community across Australia and around the world reporting on the issues that matter to you.

abcmelbourne.au.title: The Forsytes
abcmelbourne.au.description: S2 E3 Chapter 3 Irene navigates public scrutiny, Jolyon Jnr rejects his family fortune, and Soames seizes control, igniting financial, personal, and moral tensions within the family.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Parliament Question Time ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E63 House of Representatives The sitting week in parliament concludes with coverage of Question Time from the House of Representatives. The Senate next sits on Monday 16 November and the House returns on Monday 23 November.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Frankie Drake Mysteries ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: S3 E4 A Brother in Arms Frankie's floored when a man claiming to be her half-brother shows up at the agency begging her to help his wrongly imprisoned friend.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs Australia
abcmelbourne.au.description: S12 E5 Blue Mountains Tardis Builder Nick is hoping to build his wife Rachel the ultimate house in the idyllic Blue Mountains; a place that for the first time in her life, she can finally call home.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Long Lost Family
abcmelbourne.au.description: S6 E5 Episode 5 We meet one man yearning to find the father he's never met and a search for the youngest birth mother we've ever come across.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Antiques Roadshow
abcmelbourne.au.description: S33 E2 Beverley Minster 2 Fiona Bruce and the team are back for a second visit to Beverley Minster in the East Riding of Yorkshire. Hundreds of visitors pack the nave eager to see the experts.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Hard Quiz
abcmelbourne.au.description: S5 E2 Episode 2 Which expert dares tell Tom Gleeson he's wrong? Is it Young Ones fan Kreisha? Abhi, who admires heart surgeon Dr Victor Chang? Simon, who loves racehorse Makybe Diva? Or Volvo owner Frank? Hard Quiz has the answers.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E302 Thursday 29 October 2026 News from where we live. ABC News Victoria brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on the issues that matter to Victorians. Presented by Tamara Oudyn, and weather with Adam Morgan.

abcmelbourne.au.title: 7.30 ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E172 Sarah Ferguson presents Australia's premier daily current affairs program, delivering agenda-setting public affairs journalism and interviews that hold the powerful to account. Plus political analysis from Jacob Greber.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs New Zealand ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: S10 E3 Huntsbury An environmentally-committed young couple in Christchurch buck convention by going back to the future with a centuries-old building material.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Joanna Lumley's Danube: Europe's Mightiest River
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Join Joanna Lumley as she explores the pearl of the Danube Budapest by boat, rides the Children's Railway, discovers the city's Jewish heritage, meets Hungary's cowboys, and explores Dracula's Transylvania.

abcmelbourne.au.title: Dustfall
abcmelbourne.au.description: S1 E3 Episode 3 Tig and her team, working almost around the clock, use digital traces and human detection to narrow in and finally identify the mysterious 'Jack'.

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC Late News ᴺᵉʷ
abcmelbourne.au.description: E216 Thursday 29 October 2026 Know the latest on the day's top stories, as Jade Barker brings you a comprehensive roundup of the news of the day. ABC News has reporters across Australia and around the globe reporting on the issues that matter to you.
